title: Hiring AI Video Editor – Talking Avatar & Viral Shorts (Long-Term)
description:
# Hiring AI Video Editor – Talking Avatar & Viral Shorts (Long-Term)



We are looking for an **experienced AI video editor** to create short-form commentary videos for
, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.



The goal is to produce entertaining, funny, and educational videos featuring a **realistic AI talking avatar reacting to and commenting on viral videos**, similar to the example below.



**Video Example:**  





### Responsibilities



1. **Find Videos:** Research and identify interesting, funny, or educational videos on YouTube and other platforms that are suitable for commentary and can be legally reused.

2. **Create AI Avatar:** Develop a realistic, consistent AI character that will appear across all videos.

3. **AI Voice & Lip Sync:** Make the avatar speak naturally with realistic facial expressions, lip synchronization, and appropriate reactions.

4. **Script & Commentary:** Write short, engaging commentary scripts based on the original videos.

5. **Video Editing:** Combine the original footage with the talking avatar, add subtitles, transitions, sound effects, and other elements to create engaging short-form content.

6. **Final Delivery:** Export finished videos in vertical 9:16 format, ready for social media publishing.



### Project Details



- **Initial batch:** 100 completed videos

- **Video length:** 20–30 seconds each

- **Format:** Vertical 9:16 (1080 × 1920)

- **Content:** Funny, interesting, and educational videos (no explicit content)

- **Platforms:**
, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok

- **Style:** Realistic AI avatar commentary, similar to the reference video

- **Partnership:** Long-term, with regular batches of videos



### Requirements



- Experience creating realistic AI talking avatars

- Experience with AI lip-sync and voice-generation tools

- Strong short-form video editing skills

- Ability to research and select engaging video content

- Understanding of social media trends and retention-focused editing

- Ability to maintain a consistent avatar appearance and voice across videos

- Understanding of copyright, licensed content, and transformative commentary



Experience with tools such as **HeyGen, Kling, Runway, ElevenLabs, CapCut, Premiere Pro**, or similar AI and editing software is a plus.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. Examples of AI talking-avatar or commentary videos you have created.

2. The AI tools you use for avatar generation, lip sync, and editing.

3. Your **price per completed 20–30-second video**.

4. Your total price for a batch of 100 videos.

5. How many completed videos you can deliver per day.



We are looking for someone who can handle the **entire production process**, from finding the source video and creating the AI avatar to delivering the final edited video.



**This is a long-term opportunity for the right editor, with consistent work and ongoing video production.**

title: Airbnb STR Remote Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our fast-growing short-term rental management company. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, administrative support, and timely completion of operational tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and competing priorities. You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote: 40 scheduled hours per week, 8 hours per day.

- Flexible with shift schedules: Morning shift: 8am - 4pm, Evening shift: 4pm - 12am, Admin shift: 10am - 6pm.

- You must be flexible with all the shift schedules, including weekends. The schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time.



Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, direct-booking channels,
, and phone.

- Support guests throughout their stay, including booking inquiries, check-in instructions, access issues, amenity questions, and checkout.

- Resolve routine guest concerns and complaints within established policies and approval limits. Escalate urgent, sensitive, or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.

- Review reservation details, calendars, and special requests to identify potential issues and ensure accurate information.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.



Cleaning, Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaning schedules and confirm that properties are ready before guest arrival.

- Follow up with cleaners on completion status, turnover photos, missing supplies, and reported property issues.

- Contact and coordinate with maintenance technicians, handymen, landscapers, and other service providers.

- Source vendors, request quotes, confirm availability, and arrange approved services.

- Track cleaning and maintenance issues through completion, verify that the work has been completed, and keep relevant parties informed.



Administrative & Listing Support

- Create and update property listings, descriptions, photos, amenities, house rules, and check-in instructions as assigned.

- Maintain accurate property information, guest records, vendor contacts, and operational documentation.

- Complete assigned updates in Hostaway, PriceLabs, and OTA platforms according to established procedures.

- Monitor listing alerts, guest feedback, and account notifications; flag issues promptly and complete required follow-up.

- Assist with property onboarding and setup on additional booking channels by organizing information and completing assigned configuration tasks.



Task Ownership & Operational Follow-Through

- Manage your assigned inboxes, tickets, and task queues, prioritizing time-sensitive guest and property issues.

- Take ownership of tasks from initial request through confirmed resolution—not just forwarding messages or creating tickets.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

- Provide end-of-shift updates covering completed tasks, unresolved issues, pending approvals, and follow-up needs.

- Follow company SOPs, flag gaps or recurring problems, and suggest practical improvements based on day-to-day experience.





Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience supporting short-term rentals on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with STR PMS.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with guests and vendors by phone.

- Experience coordinating cleaning, maintenance, or other property-related services.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple properties, conversations, and deadlines.

- Sound judgment and problem-solving skills: able to handle routine issues independently, recognize urgency, and know when to escalate.

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable, with a strong habit of following up without repeated reminders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and learning new software, tools, and procedures.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet workspace for guest and vendor calls.

- Ability to consistently work the required Pacific Time schedule and provide the stated standby availability.

How to Apply



Growth Opportunity

Top-performing Virtual Assistants may have the opportunity to advance into a VA Manager role as the company grows.



Please submit your application and complete every question in the application form. Only applicants who complete the full form will be considered.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
We're Hiring: Marketing Assistant

Location: 100% remote (based in Philippines)

_________________________________________________

Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.



At JazzUpCo, growth comes from turning great ideas into great execution. As we continue to scale across multiple channels - from Shopify and Amazon to retail and wholesale - strong operations become increasingly important.



We’re looking for a Marketing Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will split your time between driving our Amazon channel expansion and keeping the supply chain humming through weekly inventory checks and fulfilment routines.

_________________________________________________



Role Overview



First 3–6 Months Focus

- 70% Amazon & Creative Support: Daily reporting, Amazon listing/catalog updates, case management, and creative QA for Meta ads/landing pages.



- 30% Marketing Operations & Collaborations: Managing ClickUp systems, creator/affiliate partnerships, product launch timelines, and website/multichannel tasks.



Long-Term Focus (6th Month Onward)

- 50% Amazon & Marketing Channel Operations: Owning routine Seller Central operations, forecasting, FBA shipments, and monthly performance dashboarding.



- 50% Partnerships, Creative Ops & Special Projects: Independently running creator/affiliate inbound/outbound programs, creative asset coordination, and cross-functional task tracking.



Amazon Management & Support

- Update daily sales and performance reports, monitor daily account health (compliance and listings suppression), and submit/manage Seller Central support cases.



- Build and manage biweekly FBA shipment creations (3 hrs) and maintain biweekly forecasting reports (1 hr) to support inventory alignment.



- Execute listing updates, upload image swatches (30–45 min), build/edit Premium A+ Content (30–45 min), and process multichannel orders as needed.



- Track customer reviews and product feedback on a weekly basis to flag actionable listing issues.



Marketing Operations & Assistant Support

- Act as the ClickUp project keeper (30 min–1 hr daily) to ensure task completion, monitor project workflows, and follow up on deliverable timelines.



- Maintain product launch timelines, ensuring cross-team awareness of critical dates and milestones.



- Maintain and update monthly marketing dashboards, tagging relevant stakeholders for input and review.



- Track creative briefs for external photography (Yu), ensuring assets are produced, approved, and routed on time.



Creative QA & Meta Ad Support

- Double-check landing page links on Meta Ads to verify correct product alignment and smooth user experience.



- Review editor-submitted videos and graphics for brand guideline compliance, then download and organize files in Google Drive.



- Assist with weekly monitoring and tracking of Meta Ad tasks in ClickUp.

_________________________________________________



You’re a Fit If You Have:



- Experience in building listings, uploading assets, setting up A+ Content, and managing FBA routines.



- Comfortable providing ad support by tracking keywords, impressions, and basic campaign performance metrics.



- Natural organizer who ensures processes are followed and deliverables hit their target dates.



- Comfortable with spreadsheets, order splits, warehouse clearing, and tracking overstock or out-of-stock risks.



- Friendly and professional when managing incoming creator collaborations and basic website updates.



- Detail-oriented mindset that spots typos in listings or stock count errors before they cause issues.



- Adaptable team player who thrives switching between creative marketing tasks and practical operations support.

_________________________________________________



Why Join JazzUpCo?



- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our product performance and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



- Learning & Career Path – Learn directly from the founder and consultants while sharpening your strategic project management skills and growing into a senior operations leader.



-Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and your voice is actually heard.

_________________________________________________



Our Culture: E-F-G



E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.

_________________________________________________



Next Steps:



1) Apply: Via the application form -
 (OJPH)

2) First Interview: Get to know each other

3) Trial Task: Show us how you think and execute

4) Join the Team: Onboarding + probation --> full-time hire



We can’t wait to meet you!

title: E-Commerce, AI Content & Customer Support Specialist
description:
About Us

We are Bluespoon GmbH, a fast-growing German e-commerce company specialising in premium tableware under our brand Sänger Geschirr.

Our products are sold across multiple online platforms, including Amazon, OTTO, Home24, Shopify, XXXLutz and more.

Our team is based in Germany, and we are looking for a motivated and creative team member working remotely from the Philippines to support our customer service, e-commerce operations and visual marketing content.

The Role

We are looking for a versatile E-Commerce, AI Content & Customer Support Specialist who combines strong organisational skills with creativity and an interest in AI-powered image creation.

This position covers three main areas:

• Customer Support: Handling customer inquiries, returns, refunds and order-related issues.

• AI Content & Graphic Creation: Creating and editing high-quality product images, lifestyle visuals and marketing graphics using AI tools.

• E-Commerce & Marketplace Management: Creating and maintaining product listings, managing product data and monitoring our online sales channels.

The distribution of tasks is flexible and depends on daily business needs. Some days may focus more on customer support, while others involve creating marketing visuals, improving product listings or managing marketplace operations.

We are looking for someone who can switch between different tasks, learn new tools quickly and work independently.

Your Responsibilities

1. AI Image Creation & Marketing Graphics

• Create high-quality product images, lifestyle images and marketing graphics for our e-commerce platforms

• Use AI image generation tools such as Google AI Nano Banana and ChatGPT image generation to create and edit visual content

• Transform existing product photos into attractive lifestyle scenes and realistic product presentations

• Create graphics for Amazon product listings, A+ Content, Shopify and other sales channels

• Edit and improve existing product images, including backgrounds, lighting, composition and visual presentation

• Make sure AI-generated images accurately represent our products

2. Customer Support & Order Management

• Communicate with customers via
, WhatsApp and other support channels

• Handle customer inquiries, complaints and order-related issues professionally

• Process returns, refunds, cancellations and replacement deliveries

• Create and provide return shipping labels

• Monitor orders across our sales channels to ensure timely processing and shipment

• Verify incoming payments 

• Create and manage customer orders in JTL Wawi

• Coordinate with our warehouse partner to resolve shipping issues

• Follow up on unresolved customer requests and ensure cases are completed

3. E-Commerce & Marketplace Management

• Create and maintain product listings in JTL Wawi and across our sales channels

• Enter and update product data, including SKUs, EANs, names, categories, prices and attributes

• Upload products and content to our channels and verify successful processing

• Check product pricing, availability and listing status across marketplaces

• Assist with product content improvements and marketplace compliance documentation

• Ensure product information and images remain accurate and consistent across all platforms

4. General E-Commerce & Backoffice Tasks

• Monitor stock availability and coordinate updates with our warehouse partner

• Verify price updates across different sales channels

• Create manual orders for B2B customers and influencers

• Maintain accurate customer, order and product data

• Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements

• Support additional operational and administrative tasks when needed

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have:

• Previous experience in customer support, e-commerce or online retail

• Experience with AI image generation or editing tools, such as Google AI Nano Banana, ChatGPT image generation or similar tools

• A good eye for design, image composition and visually appealing product presentations

• Ability to create professional-looking graphics and improve existing product images

• Good English communication skills, both written and spoken

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to manage different responsibilities and switch priorities depending on workload

• Independent, reliable and proactive working style

• Ability to quickly learn new software, tools and processes

• Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

• Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-oriented mindset

• Stable internet connection and a professional remote working environment

Nice-to-Have:

• German language skills – a strong advantage

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or other e-commerce marketplaces

• Knowledge of JTL Wawi or comparable ERP systems

• Experience with Canva, Photoshop or other graphic design tools

• Experience creating Amazon A+ Content, product infographics or e-commerce lifestyle images

• Knowledge of AI prompting techniques for realistic product image generation

• Familiarity with customer support tools such as Outlook, Greyhound or Google Workspace

• Experience processing returns, refunds and marketplace orders

• Understanding of marketplace image requirements and e-commerce product presentation

What We Offer

• Part-time remote position – work from the Philippines

• Long-term opportunity with a growing German e-commerce company

• Varied responsibilities combining creative AI content creation, customer support and e-commerce operations

• Opportunity to work with modern AI tools and develop new skills

• Clearly documented processes and structured onboarding

• Direct collaboration with our team in Germany

• Opportunity to take on more responsibilities over time

• A professional and supportive working environment

How to Apply

Please send us:

1. Your CV / resume (in English)

2. A short cover letter (3–5 sentences) explaining your relevant experience and why you would be a good fit for this role

3. A 1–2 minute introduction video introducing yourself, your previous experience and why you would like to join our team

4. Examples of your work: Please share 2–3 examples of product images, marketing graphics or AI-generated visuals you have created. If possible, include examples created using tools such as ChatGPT, Google AI Nano Banana or similar AI image generation tools.

Applications without all four items will not be considered.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Financial & Revenue Performance Analyst  | Long-Term Opportunity | European Health & Beauty Business
description:
Part-Time Financial & Revenue Performance Analyst (FP&A / Power BI)



Initial 40-Hour Project | 3 - 5 Hours/Week Ongoing | Long-Term Opportunity | European Health & Beauty Business



We are looking for a highly capable, analytical and commercially minded Financial & Revenue Performance Analyst to support a growing premium health, beauty and wellness company based in Iceland.



This is not a bookkeeping, accounting or general virtual assistant role.



We are looking for someone who is highly confident in Power BI, Excel, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and business performance reporting.



You should enjoy working with numbers, understanding how a business operates, identifying financial risks and opportunities, and turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.



You will work directly with the Founder/CEO, but the goal is not for you to wait for daily instructions.



We want someone who can gradually take ownership of our financial and operational performance monitoring, identify trends and potential problems early, and proactively recommend ways to improve revenue, profitability, cost efficiency and cash flow.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting



* Build and maintain our annual financial budget, broken down by month

* Forecast revenue, operating expenses, profitability and cash requirements

* Compare actual financial performance against budgets and targets

* Analyse monthly and year-to-date variances

* Explain why results are above or below expectations

* Maintain a rolling forecast for the remainder of the financial year

* Identify potential financial risks before they become problems

* Recommend corrective actions when the business is not on track to meet its targets



Cash Flow Monitoring & Forecasting



* Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast

* Monitor expected cash inflows and outflows

* Identify potential cash shortages in advance

* Analyse how changes in revenue, expenses and payment timing affect cash flow

* Monitor progress against cash reserve targets

* Recommend practical actions to strengthen liquidity and cash generation

* Provide clear early warnings when action may be required



Cost Analysis & Expense Optimisation



* Review operating expenses and recurring subscriptions

* Identify unused software, unnecessary costs and duplicated services

* Analyse spending trends and unusual cost increases

* Compare actual expenses against budget

* Identify opportunities to reduce costs without negatively affecting operations

* Evaluate the potential financial impact of proposed savings

* Track whether approved cost-saving measures deliver the expected results



Revenue Performance & Growth Opportunities



* Analyse revenue trends by month, treatment category and service

* Monitor average sales value and revenue per client

* Identify opportunities to increase revenue from existing clients and services

* Evaluate potential pricing changes and their financial impact

* Analyse treatment packages, pricing structures and revenue opportunities

* Model different revenue scenarios and their expected financial outcomes

* Identify underperforming services and opportunities to improve profitability

* Proactively recommend practical ways to increase recurring revenue and overall business performance



We want someone who can say:



“If we increase the price of this treatment by a small amount, based on current sales volume, here is the potential monthly and annual financial impact.”



Or:



“Based on current trends, we may fall below next month’s revenue target. Here is the estimated gap and what I recommend we do.”



Capacity, Booking Utilisation & Revenue Forecasting



We operate a treatment-based clinic where revenue is closely connected to booking capacity and utilisation.



You will help us understand how effectively we are using our available capacity.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor current treatment booking utilisation

* Analyse available treatment capacity versus booked appointments

* Forecast expected utilisation and revenue for the coming weeks and months

* Identify periods with low booking demand or underutilised capacity

* Identify situations where additional staff availability may be needed

* Analyse revenue generated per treatment and per booked hour

* Evaluate how improvements in utilisation could affect revenue and profitability

* Recommend when operational or sales actions may be required to improve performance



The goal is to identify opportunities and risks early, rather than reacting after the month has already ended.



Sales Performance & Treatment Profitability



* Analyse average transaction value and average revenue per client

* Calculate average realised revenue per treatment

* Analyse direct treatment costs where data is available

* Evaluate contribution margins across different treatment categories

* Identify which treatments generate the strongest financial returns

* Analyse revenue and contribution per treatment hour

* Evaluate the profitability of different pricing and package structures

* Identify opportunities to improve revenue without unnecessarily increasing operating costs



You should understand the difference between selling a prepaid treatment package, receiving cash and delivering the treatments over time.



Power BI Dashboards & Reporting



Strong hands-on Power BI experience is an essential requirement for this position.



You will be responsible for building and maintaining clear, practical dashboards that help management understand business performance.



This includes:



* Build and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards

* Import, clean and transform data using Power Query

* Create reliable data models and relationships

* Build DAX measures and financial KPIs

* Develop dashboards for revenue, expenses, profitability, cash flow, sales and utilisation

* Compare actual performance against budgets and forecasts

* Create clear visual indicators for trends, variances and potential risks

* Establish repeatable data refresh and reporting processes

* Document data sources, calculations and dashboard maintenance procedures

* Continuously improve reporting accuracy, clarity and usefulness



We are not looking for dashboards that simply look impressive.



We want dashboards that help us make better business decisions.



Proactive Financial Monitoring & Recommendations



One of the most important parts of this role is identifying what management needs to know before being asked.



You will be expected to:



* Monitor agreed financial and operational KPIs

* Identify significant changes or concerning trends

* Highlight risks to revenue, profitability and cash flow

* Investigate unexpected results

* Prepare concise explanations and recommended next steps

* Prioritise recommendations based on their likely financial impact

* Follow up on approved improvements and measure their results



We want someone who can say:



“I noticed this is not performing as expected. Here is what I found, what it means financially, and what I recommend we do next.”



Rather than simply waiting to be told what to analyse.



Initial Project — First Two Weeks



The position begins with an approximately 40-hour paid setup and analysis project, ideally completed within two weeks.



The purpose of this initial project is to establish a practical financial and operational performance monitoring system.



This will include:



* Reviewing available financial and operational data

* Analysing historical revenue and operating expenses

* Identifying initial cost-saving opportunities

* Establishing a monthly annual budget and forecast

* Building a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast

* Creating an initial capacity and utilisation forecasting model

* Establishing key revenue, sales and profitability metrics

* Building the first functional Power BI management dashboard

* Preparing an initial financial performance report

* Presenting key findings, risks, opportunities and recommended actions

* Documenting the ongoing reporting and monitoring process



The goal is to create a reliable, usable first version of the system, not to spend unnecessary time building something overly complicated.



More advanced automation or additional analysis can be developed later if justified.



Successful completion of the initial project may lead to an ongoing part-time position.



Ongoing Responsibilities



After the initial setup, the role will focus on maintaining the system and providing regular financial and operational insights.



Weekly:



* Update cash-flow and short-term revenue forecasts

* Monitor upcoming booking utilisation

* Identify important risks, variances and opportunities

* Flag issues requiring management attention



Monthly:



* Update financial dashboards and management reports

* Compare actual performance against budget

* Review revenue, costs, profitability and cash generation

* Update forecasts for the remaining year

* Review cost-saving and revenue improvement opportunities

* Present a concise summary of findings and recommended actions



We value clear conclusions and useful recommendations over lengthy reports.



The Person We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have proven experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A)

* Have strong, practical experience with Microsoft Power BI

* Are highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets

* Can independently build budgets and financial forecasts

* Understand cash-flow forecasting and financial performance analysis

* Are comfortable analysing revenue, expenses and profitability

* Have experience creating financial dashboards and KPI reports

* Understand data modelling, Power Query and DAX

* Can work with data from different business systems

* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

* Understand the commercial impact behind financial numbers

* Have excellent written English

* Have exceptional attention to detail

* Can work independently with minimal supervision

* Are proactive, reliable and highly organised

* Can explain complex financial information in simple, practical language

* Naturally look for ways to improve business performance



Experience with service-based businesses, clinics, wellness businesses or appointment-based operations is a strong advantage.



Experience with Shopify, booking systems or financial reporting automation is also an advantage.



Most importantly, we want someone who thinks beyond the spreadsheet.



Someone who understands that the purpose of financial analysis is not simply to report what happened, but to help the business make better decisions about what happens next.



How We Work



We use Notion as our central operating system.



Your tasks, projects, deadlines, documentation and time tracking will be managed there.



Financial models and reporting may be maintained in Excel or Google Sheets, with Power BI used as our primary management dashboard.



We believe in clear ownership, reliable reporting and proactive communication.



For recurring responsibilities, the goal is that you know what needs to be reviewed, when it needs to be updated and what good performance looks like without the CEO having to assign every individual task.



We also value documentation.



If something becomes recurring, we want to turn it into a repeatable process, template, checklist or automation.



The objective is to make our financial reporting more accurate, efficient and increasingly independent of the Founder/CEO.



About The House of Beauty



The House of Beauty is a premium, multi-award-winning health, wellness and non-invasive body clinic based in Reykjavík, Iceland.



We have been operating for 8+ years and have delivered 50,000+ treatments.



Our clients are primarily women, and our brand combines premium client experience with specialist expertise, technology and results-focused treatments.



We are now strengthening the financial and operational systems behind the business to support more predictable revenue, stronger profitability, improved cash flow and sustainable long-term growth.



Hours & Compensation



* Initial paid project: approximately 40 hours over two weeks

* Ongoing workload: approximately 3 hours per week / 12 hours per month

* $8–12 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities

* Long-term opportunity for the right person

* Fully remote position

* Paid hourly with time tracking

* Initial 3-month probationary period for the ongoing role

* Additional hours only by prior agreement



We care more about accuracy, commercial insight, ownership and results than simply logging hours.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Start your application with the words: “THOB Finance”



This helps us confirm that you read the full job description.



2. Tell us about your experience with:



* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

* Power BI

* Excel / Google Sheets

* Budgeting & Forecasting

* Cash Flow Forecasting

* Financial Dashboards & KPI Reporting



3. Rate yourself from 1–10 in each of those six areas.



4. Give us one real example of a financial dashboard, forecast or reporting system you personally built or significantly improved.



Explain:



* What was the business problem?

* What data sources did you work with?

* What did you personally build or analyse?

* What was the result or business impact?



5. Imagine you join us and discover that our revenue is 15% below budget, while operating expenses are 10% above budget.



What would you investigate first, and what information would you need before recommending actions?



6. Imagine that our treatment booking utilisation is significantly below target for next month.



How would you analyse the situation and identify opportunities to improve revenue?



7. Please describe your Power BI experience.



Include examples of dashboards you have personally built, your experience with Power Query and DAX, and how you have handled data refreshes.



8. How many hours per week are you currently committed to other clients or employment?



9. What is your current working schedule and timezone?



10. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



11. Please include links, screenshots or examples of relevant Power BI dashboards, financial models or reports where possible.



Please remove any confidential client or employer information before sharing examples.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview.

We currently service over 50 holiday rental properties and are expanding. We specialise in professional Airbnb turnovers, linen management, quality control and ensuring properties are ready for incoming guests.



We are looking for a reliable, highly organised and proactive Virtual Assistant to join our team long-term.

3. Quality Control & Reporting



* Monitor cleaning completion reports and QC results.

* Follow up on outstanding inspections.

4. Administration

Requirements



* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Operations Coordinator or Scheduling Assistant.

title: ₱10,000 Referral Fee – Help Us Find a Private Country Home for Rent in Luzon
description:
Hii !



We're searching for a genuinely private and peaceful home to rent long-term in rural Luzon (6 Months to 1+ year), and we're offering a ₱10,000 referral fee to anyone who introduces us to a property we ultimately lease.



We're not looking for luxury. We're looking for privacy, peace, natural surroundings, and a comfortable place to call home.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR...



:)  A standalone house, farmhouse, rest house, or private residential property surrounded by nature.

:)  Genuine privacy is our highest priority. Ideally, no immediate neighbors, nearby houses, or properties above the home.

:)  A generous amount of surrounding land, trees, farmland, or open space.

:)  A comfortable, livable house with electricity, running water, and reliable internet (or ability for us to have StarLink).

:)  Accessible by an ordinary vehicle throughout the year.

:)  Suitable for long-term rental rather than short-term vacation stays.

:)  Pet-friendly (two indoor cats).



LOCATION...



We're looking for rural properties in Luzon, within a maximum of approximately 4 hours' driving distance from Metro Manila in any direction. We're particularly interested in peaceful agricultural communities, mountain foothills, and countryside locations with plenty of open space and privacy.



We're flexible about the province, but the 4-hour-ish driving limit is important because we need reasonable access to Metro Manila, including the airport and government services.



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR...



:(  Subdivisions, gated communities, or densely populated neighborhoods.

:(  Homes with immediate neighbors or shared residential compounds.

:(  Properties along busy roads or surrounded by commercial activity.

:(  Vacation resorts that aren't available for long-term rental.

:(  Homes that appear private in photographs but are actually surrounded by other houses.



HOW THE REFERRAL FEE WORKS...



If you introduce us to a suitable property and we ultimately sign a rental agreement, we'll pay you ₱10,000 upon signing the lease! You don't need to be a real estate agent. Perhaps a relative owns an unused farmhouse, a neighbor has a vacant countryside property, or you simply know someone who might be willing to rent their home.



We're particularly interested in privately owned properties that may not be advertised online.



This is not an hourly position or a request for online property research. It's a referral opportunity with a one-time payment for a successful introduction.



INTERESTED? LET'S TALK!



If you know of a property that might be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you! You don't need to have everything ready when you first contact us. A simple introduction about a potential property is perfectly fine.



However, anyone pursuing the ₱10,000 referral fee will be responsible for contacting the property owner, confirming their willingness to rent long-term, and gathering the information we need to evaluate the property. This includes photos of the house and surrounding area, the proposed rental price, and a Google Maps location pin so we can examine the property and its surroundings using satellite imagery.



Privacy is extremely important to us, so being able to verify the property's location and proximity to neighboring houses is essential before arranging a viewing. We're happy to discuss promising leads, but we're looking for someone who can help facilitate the introduction and communication with the owner, not simply provide a name or address.



We're actively searching and will be traveling to view properties this weekend, so promising leads may have an opportunity for a viewing on short notice!



Thanks so much!!

title: # Hiring: Creative Social Media & Growth VA | Canva, AI Characters, Reels & Carousels
description:
# Hiring: Creative Social Media & Growth VA | Canva, AI Characters, Reels & Carousels



**Starting Salary:** $150 USD/week + Viral Performance Bonuses / Salary of $150 Paid Every Friday & Bonus Paid Every 30 days

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Position:** Long-Term  

**Publishing Schedule:** 7 Days Per Week  

**Platforms:** Instagram, TikTok,
 & YouTube Shorts



## About the Role



We are building an exciting relationship and lifestyle media brand focused on love, dating, meaningful conversations, and human connection.



We are looking for a highly creative, detail-oriented Social Media Virtual Assistant with an excellent eye for aesthetics, strong design skills, and a good understanding of what makes social media content engaging, shareable, and capable of attracting new followers.



Our goal is to build a beautiful, recognizable, fast-growing brand through consistent, high-quality content.



We want someone who understands modern social media aesthetics, AI-generated visuals, faceless content, and how to make people stop scrolling.



**This is primarily a visual content creation, design, and scheduling role, with an emphasis on creativity, consistency, and organic growth.**



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



## What We Will Provide



We will provide everything you need to create the content:



- All written content, relationship questions, captions, and ideas in an organized Excel spreadsheet.

- Our existing AI character image, which you will reuse consistently across different posts.

- Access to paid AI tools for creating new backgrounds, outfits, poses, and realistic settings featuring the same character.

- Canva, Buffer, 
, and other necessary design, editing, and scheduling tools.

- Brand colors, visual guidelines, creative direction, and feedback.



**All required software subscriptions and AI tools will be paid for by us. You will not be expected to purchase any software or pay for subscriptions.**



You will not be responsible for researching or writing content, creating the original AI character, or developing the overall content strategy.



Your responsibility is to transform our provided content into beautiful, engaging, professional social media posts.



## Your Responsibilities



### 1. Create 9 Unique Content Pieces Daily



You will create **9 unique pieces of content per day, 7 days per week (63 pieces weekly)** using the written content we provide.



These 9 pieces will be repurposed and distributed across Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.



**IMPORTANT: This means 9 total unique content pieces per day, NOT 9 different posts for each platform.**



Content formats will include:



- Beautiful, modern Instagram carousels.

- Faceless reels and short-form videos.

- AI-character-based images and videos.

- Aesthetic text-based posts.

- Relationship quotes and meaningful conversation prompts.

- Engaging newsletter promotional content.



You should understand how to take simple written content and turn it into visually appealing, polished, shareable posts.



### 2. AI Character Content Creation



We will provide the original AI character image and access to paid AI generation tools.



Your responsibilities include:



- Reusing the same AI character consistently across posts.

- Placing the character in different realistic backgrounds and settings.

- Changing outfits, poses, environments, and scenarios while maintaining character consistency.

- Creating photorealistic AI images and short videos.

- Ensuring the character looks natural, realistic, and recognizable.

- Maintaining a consistent visual identity across all content.



Experience using reference images to maintain consistent AI characters is highly preferred.



### 3. Visual Branding & Aesthetics



We want someone with an exceptional eye for design who understands modern social media aesthetics.



You will:



- Develop beautiful, recognizable Canva templates.

- Maintain consistent brand colors, typography, and visual identity.

- Create a cohesive, aesthetically pleasing Instagram feed.

- Choose attractive layouts, animations, transitions, and music.

- Create strong visual hooks that encourage people to stop scrolling.

- Ensure all content is modern, professional, and easy to read on mobile devices.

- Suggest fresh visual formats and creative approaches.



We do not want generic, repetitive, or poorly designed content. We want a recognizable visual identity that people associate with our brand.



### 4. Scheduling & Publishing



Our content must be published consistently **7 days per week**.



Your responsibilities include:



- Scheduling and distributing content using Buffer, 
, or similar tools.

- Adapting content dimensions and formats for each platform.

- Following our Excel content calendar.

- Maintaining a consistent daily posting schedule.

- Organizing Canva projects, AI visuals, reels, and completed content.

- Ensuring all content is scheduled and published correctly.



**Content can be created and scheduled in advance. You do not need to work seven days per week as long as all 63 weekly content pieces are completed, approved, and scheduled to publish consistently throughout the week.**



We value efficiency, organization, and the ability to work independently.



### 5. Social Media Growth & Creative Improvement



- Understand what makes content engaging, shareable, and effective at attracting new followers.

- Stay updated on social media trends, viral formats, and visual hooks that perform well with U.S. audiences.

- Suggest creative ways to improve content presentation and organic growth.

- Replicate and improve successful formats based on feedback and performance insights we provide.

- Create content that encourages engagement, shares, follows, and newsletter subscriptions.



**Note:** We will handle analytics, performance tracking, and overall growth strategy. Your role is to use your creativity and social media knowledge to support audience growth.



## Required Skills



- Advanced Canva design skills.

- Strong CapCut or similar video editing experience.

- Experience creating Instagram carousels and faceless reels.

- Experience working with AI-generated characters using reference images.

- Familiarity with AI image and video generation tools.

- Knowledge of Buffer, 
, or similar scheduling tools.

- Understanding of Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Excellent visual design skills and attention to detail.

- Understanding of social media engagement and organic growth.

- Ability to follow creative direction and meet deadlines.

- Good written English.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently.



## Compensation, Bonuses & Salary Growth



**Starting Salary: $150 USD per week, paid every Friday.**



We are building this brand for the long term and want someone who is excited to grow with us.



**Your starting salary is not intended to remain the same as the business grows.**



As the brand expands and generates more revenue, there will be opportunities for salary increases based on business performance, reliability, quality of work, and your contributions.



### Viral Performance Bonuses



We offer additional bonuses for original content reaching the following organic view milestones within 30 days of publication:



- **100,000–499,999 views:** $25 bonus

- **500,000–999,999 views:** $50 bonus

- **1,000,000+ views:** $75 bonus



Bonuses are awarded per qualifying original content piece, based on the highest milestone achieved.



Bonuses are not cumulative. Repurposed versions of the same content across multiple platforms count as one original piece, with the highest individual platform view count determining the bonus.



Only organic views qualify. Paid advertising, purchased views, and artificial engagement are excluded.



We will handle performance tracking and bonus verification.



## Paid Creative Trial – 6 Posts



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid creative trial using content, brand guidelines, and tools we provide.



The trial will include:



- 2 Instagram carousels.

- 2 faceless reels.

- 2 AI-character-based posts.



We will evaluate:



- Creativity and overall aesthetics.

- Quality of Canva designs.

- Video editing and transitions.

- AI character consistency.

- Understanding of engaging social media formats.

- Ability to follow creative direction.

- Attention to detail and professionalism.



Trial compensation will be agreed upon before starting.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your portfolio featuring your best carousels, reels, and faceless content.

2. Examples of AI-generated character content you've created.

3. The AI, design, editing, and scheduling tools you're familiar with.

4. Examples of social media accounts you've created content for.

5. Your availability and experience creating content for U.S.-based audiences.



**IMPORTANT: Start your application with "CREATIVE GROWTH" so we know you've read the entire job description.**



We're looking for someone creative, reliable, organized, and excited about helping build a beautiful, recognizable, fast-growing media brand.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person to develop their skills, contribute creatively, and grow financially as the business succeeds.

title: YouTube Tutorial Video Creator (Short How-To Tutorials)
description:
Hello! Nice to meet you!

We are looking for a YouTube tutorial video creator who can create short, simple step-by-step tutorials.



What We Expect From You:



You must be able to record short, 1-4 minute how-to tutorials without showing your face, only recording the screen and using your own voiceover, narrating the steps and explaining what you’re doing. You will be recording your computer or your phone screen. An example of a video would be “How to delete an Instagram account”.



Here’s exactly what this will look like. I’ll give you the name of the software/tool/app and the exact topic. Then, you do the following:

1. Learn how to use the software/tool/app and how to perform the steps required to record the video (on your own).

2. Record your screen showing the steps required in 1080p Full HD quality, clearly narrating the steps as you go.

3. Do some very basic editing, like cutting mistakes, removing pauses and blurring sensitive information.

4. Upload the finished video file to the provided Google Drive folder.



Fancy editing is NOT NEEDED. Clean recording and clear narration are what matter.



REQUIRED SKILLS:

- Fluent English

- Basic/intermediate computer skills

- The ability to explain what you’re showing on the screen

- You can open a web app/software you have seen for the first time and figure out how it works on your own, either by exploring it yourself, watching videos about it or finding the information online.

- Basic editing skills (only for editing out pauses/errors and blurring sensitive information)

- Willingness to learn & attention to detail



REQUIRED TOOLS:

- A computer and a smartphone

- Good microphone (good audio quality, no background noise, etc.)

- OBS (recommended) or any other recording software

- Trello (for workflow management)

- Discord / WhatsApp for communication

*If you’ve got any other tools (such as gaming consoles,…), please let me know, since that’s a big plus!



RESPONSIBILITIES:

You will get the topics for the videos (e.g. “how to delete an Instagram account”), record them (+explain what’s happening using your own voice), cut out the pauses & mistakes, and upload the videos to Google Drive. That’s literally it.



DAY-TO-DAY TASKS: 

Every day, you will get a set amount of topics to record. You will then simply have to record tutorials on those topics and upload them to Google Drive. We will start with 15 videos a day, and if you do a good job, we can increase the number, which will increase your earnings as well.



PAYMENT:

The payment is $1.20 per video, and if you do a good job, stay consistent, deliver on time and make sure the quality is top-notch, I’m willing to increase the per-video rate, as well as reward you with bonuses. These videos don’t require much time to make, and when you get used to it, you could easily make a few videos per hour, meaning your hourly rate will likely exceed $6 per hour. With the initial 15 videos per day, we’re looking at around $540 per month.



This is a work-from-home job with flexible hours! It doesn’t matter when you work; the only thing that matters is that work is done. No special prior experience is needed, as recording these videos is very simple with some common computer skills.



HOW TO APPLY:

1. Apply for the job

2. Send us a message, telling us a bit about yourself and why you think you’d be great for this job. 

3. Send us a sample of your previous work. If you’ve never recorded a video, you can just record a simple tutorial called “how to upload an image in Google Sheets” and send us that.

4. Begin the application with the word “Pineapple”, so we know you read this entire thing.



When you get hired, there’s a paid test period of 3 recorded videos. I never ask for unpaid work.



Best regards, and we’re looking forward to working with you!

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience working from performance data or iterating ads based on results

- After Effects, Photoshop, Figma or graphic-design ability

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

- Familiarity with Airtable, 
, Slack or comparable production tools

- Experience creating multiple hooks or variations from one core concept



WHAT WE OFFER

- Exposure to real e-commerce brands and creative that runs in live ad accounts

- The chance to see what actually performs, rather than editing in a results vacuum

title: Supply Chain Manager for Dropshipping (Long Term)
description:
Hi,



For our Dutch dropshipping business, we are aiming to hit a nice 7 figures this year. Therefore, we are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager with dropshipping expertise to join our team for a long-term position.

We are looking for long-term employees to join our team. There is a great deal of growth opportunity for those that consistently make a positive contribution to our company. We are seeking great candidates that will represent the company with great supply chain management, and dedication.



MUST HAVE KNOWLEDGE OF THESE PLATFORMS:

• Shopify (eCommerce platform)

• Slack (communication channel)

• Spreadsheet/Excel (sheet)

• Track123 (check if the orders are sent correctly)

• Google Sheets, at a daily working level. You will own several live sheets across our stores.

• Service Points (our supplier portal for quotes, COGS and order issues). Experience is a plus, full training is provided.



Responsibilities:

• Check our Customer Support Team.

• Check our Supplier.

• Check open orders.

• Provide daily updates on order status and supplier performance.

• Coordinate with suppliers to ensure efficient order processing.

• Monitor the Open Order Sheet and minimize outstanding orders.

• Keep all supply chain sheets accurate and current the same day. We run AI agents that read these sheets every night and flag what is missing or late, so the quality of your updates is visible immediately. Your job is acting on those flags, not manual reporting.

• Request and process supplier quotes in the Service Points portal, on time and complete.

• Review and process price adjustments so that COGS stays at or below 28% per store. Above 30% is loss-making, which makes 



this our number one KPI.

• Conduct quality checks during scaling and stay in touch with the product research team regarding common return reasons.

• Monitor and update Track123 to reduce outstanding orders.

• Ensure accurate and timely handling of cancellations and returns done by CS, managed by you.

• Proactively coordinate with CS to inform customers about delivery issues, address errors, and stock availability.

• Monitor KPIs and optimize supply chain processes.

• Make sure to ask for refunds at the supplier when orders are not being shipped or cancelled.

• Make sure that we respond to customer
s regarding open orders, pick-up orders, etc.

• Contribute to our documentation and improve our support processes.

• Demonstrate a high level of professionalism at all times.



We will provide you with:

• A two-week onboarding process to set you up for success from the owner and the back end manager

• A well-structured workflow provided at every step of the process including SOP's

• Video call trainings through Zoom

• Direct training from the account manager of our supplier portal (Service Points)

• AI agents that handle the daily monitoring, so you spend your time on decisions instead of admin

• SOP to follow

• A salary based on your experience, which we discuss in the interview

• Career growth opportunities within the team



Applicant needs to:

• Speak fluent English both written and verbally.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in Supply Chain Management.

• Be available for weekly team calls with the back end manager.

• Must be organized, motivated, and willing to learn and grow.

• Available to join immediately.

• List every other job or client you currently have, including hours per week. We are fine with it, we are not fine with finding out later.



Hours: the number of hours is based on order volume per store, so your hours grow as we grow. We explain exactly how this works in the interview. Please indicate how many hours you are available now and how far you could scale up.

As our Supply Chain Manager, you play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of our logistics and fulfillment processes within our fast-growing dropshipping business. You are responsible for coordinating with suppliers, monitoring shipments, and optimizing workflows. Your efforts ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time, and that our products meet the highest quality standards. Your analytical skills and attention to detail contribute to reducing delays, minimizing errors, and improving customer satisfaction.

Please respond by telling me what similar experience you have had before and tell me why you think you are a good fit for this job!



In your application, also answer this question: a product costs us 8.40 euro landed and we sell it for 34.95 euro. What is the COGS percentage, and is that inside or outside a 28% target?



Please apply with the word strawberry before you introduce yourself. Applications that read as AI-generated will not be answered.



I look forward to your proposal.



Thank you.

Jeff

title: Local SEO specialist, plumbing company (Gold Coast + Brisbane, 10 hrs/week, ongoing)
description:
I run a plumbing company. We're a bit over a year old, we've got a few hundred Google reviews sitting at 5.0, and we run vans in two markets: the Gold Coast and Brisbane's southside. Business is good. The phone rings. We're not a startup asking you to work on a dream.



I'm keeping the business name off the ad for now. You'll get everything, including full access, the moment we start the trial. Happy to tell you on a call before that if you make the shortlist.



What we're not good at is Google.



Two markets, and they're different jobs.



Gold Coast is where we're established. Vans, reviews, a known name, and we still sit around position 30 to 40 for everything that brings in work: "plumber gold coast", "blocked drains gold coast", "emergency plumber gold coast", "hot water gold coast", "leak detection gold coast" and the suburb versions. We're close. We just can't get over the line.



Brisbane is the bigger prize and we're nowhere. It's four times the search volume of the Gold Coast at the same competitiveness, and Brisbane jobs are worth more to us on average. We get work up there now purely by a
, with no marketing at all. Same searches, Brisbane versions: "plumber brisbane", "blocked drains brisbane", "emergency plumber brisbane", "hot water brisbane", plus the southside suburbs.



I'll be straight with you about the rest, because I'd rather you know now than find out in week two:



Our domain authority is 8. The bloke beating us is on 26.

We've got two Google Business Profiles. The Gold Coast one has a few hundred reviews and is going backwards. The Brisbane one has about a dozen and barely exists.

Google showed our Gold Coast listing to two and a half times more people in September than in June, and the same 28 people rang. Something's broken and I don't know what.

I've been through four agencies in two months. Every one of them talked about compounding returns and none of them showed me a single client result. I'm done with that. I want one good person who does the work and tells me the truth.



What you'd be doing

About 10 hours a week, ongoing.



1. Links. This is the main game. Authority 8 against 26 is the whole problem, and real local links are the only fix. Suppliers we buy from, sports clubs we sponsor, community groups, local news, trade associations, business groups. In both cities, because a Gold Coast link does nothing for a Brisbane ranking. You find them, you write the outreach, you chase it, you track it.



No paid link packages. No PBNs. No scraped directory lists. No guest post farms. If it comes from a network or a marketplace, the answer is no. I'd rather have six real links in six months than sixty rubbish ones.



2. Both Google Business Profiles, equally. Categories, services, service areas, Q&A, products, photo naming. Monthly audit of each listing against the top three competitors in its own city. Two jobs here: work out why 361 people looked at the Gold Coast listing in September and only 28 rang, and get the Brisbane listing from 13 reviews to something that competes.



3. Suburb and service pages. One to two a week. We'll give you a blueprint, a suburb list, real job photos and real job details. You write it as a Google Doc, we publish it. You never touch the website.



Gold Coast priorities: Oxenford, Helensvale, Southport, Runaway Bay. Brisbane priorities: Wishart, Mount Gravatt, Coorparoo and the surrounding southside.



Split your time across both cities. If you think one deserves more than the other, tell me why and I'll probably agree with you.



4. A one page weekly report. Position and clicks for 15 tracked searches, what moved, what you did, what's next. Plain English. If I need to Google a word in your report, it's the wrong word.



5. A monthly technical check. Search Console coverage and page speed. Flag what needs the developer. Flag only, don't fix.



What you get from me

Read-only Search Console and Analytics

Manager access to both Google Business Profiles

Page blueprint, suburb list, citation sheets, photo library, brand notes

A Drive folder for drafts and tracking

Answers within a day. If you're waiting on me to approve something, chase me. I'd rather be chased than be the reason nothing moved.

Paid on time, every time.

The rules

Business name, address, phone and hours are fixed. Never change them anywhere.

Only the offers we already run. No new prices or discounts in any copy.

Nothing published, submitted or paid for without my OK.

No AI pages pasted in as-is. Use it to research and draft if you like, but I'll know, and so will Google.

How to apply

Here's the part that matters. I'm going to check everything you send, so please don't send anything you'd rather I didn't look at.



1. One result, that I can verify myself. A live URL, one search term, and the city or country it ranks in. I'm going to type that search in and look. Tell me where it started, where it got to, and how long it took.



2. A Search Console screenshot with the dates visible. Six months apart if you've got it. Blur the client's name, I don't care who they are. I care that the dates and the line are real.



3. One link you personally got built. The live URL of the page your link sits on. Not a directory, not a chamber of commerce listing, not a paid guest post. A real page on a real site that said yes because you asked well.



4. Answer these two in plain English:



Our authority is 8, the leader's is 26. What are your first three moves, and roughly how long before I'd see anything?

We're close on the Gold Coast and nowhere in Brisbane. Where would you spend the first month, and why?

5. The paid task. Tell me you want it and I'll send you one of our suburb pages. Give me three changes you'd make and why. I'll pay you $100 AUD for that whether I hire you or not, because I think asking people to work for free is how you end up with people who've got nothing better to do.



Rate and next step

$15 to $25 USD an hour, depending on what you show me. 10 hours a week to start, more later if it's working.



One month paid trial with targets we agree up front, then ongoing.



Don't apply if

You can't show me a real result on a real site

Your plan involves buying links

You want to redesign the website

You'd rather send me a proposal than a result

If you've read this far and you reckon you're the one, I'd genuinely love to hear from you. Tell me the three moves and send the link. That's all I need to know.



Thanks, Blake

title: Product Research & Listing Manager for Dropshipping (AI-Assisted)
description:
Hi,



For our Dutch dropshipping business, we are aiming to hit a nice 7 figures this year. We run several stores across Europe and we are looking for an experienced Product Research and Listing Manager to join our team for a long-term position.

Read this part carefully, because this role is different from most listing jobs.



Our product research and our product listings are produced by AI agents. The agents find the products, write the listings and create the drafts. We are not looking for someone to do that work by hand. We are looking for a manager who checks everything the agents produce, keeps the overview across all stores, and actively makes the output better every week.

So your day is not data entry. Your day is judgment: d
 which researched products are actually worth selling, catching what the agents got wrong before a product goes live, and telling us exactly which rules need to change so the same mistake does not come back.



The 3 skills that matter most for this role:

1. Product research judgment. You can look at a researched product and tell us whether it is a real winner or just noise, and you can explain which signals convinced you. Competitor stores, ad activity, pricing and demand, not gut feeling.

2. Quality control at detail level. You review listings before they go
 title, product category, price, variants, images, description and language. You catch the one wrong field in a batch of fifty products.

3. Pattern feedback. When you find a mistake, you do not just report that one product. You spot the pattern, name the rule that is missing, and feed that back to us so the agents improve. This is the part most applicants cannot do, and it is the part we value most.



Tools you will work in (we train you on these):

• Shopify (eCommerce platform)

• Google Sheets (our research and listing sheets, your main workspace)

• Slack (communication channel)

Responsibilities:

• Review every researched product the agents deliver and mark it Approved or Rejected, with a short reason.

• Review the listing drafts the agents create and activate the ones that are correct. Nothing goes live without your check.

• Verify the product category on every product before activating it. This field drives our Google Shopping feed, so it is not optional.

• Check listings across stores in French, Spanish, Polish and German. You do not need to speak these languages, you work with our checklists and translation tools, but you do need to be precise.

• Keep the overview per store: which collections are too thin, which categories are missing products, where research should focus next.

• Send a short daily report on what you reviewed, what you rejected and why.

• Give us structured weekly feedback on where the agents underperform, so we can improve the rules behind them.

• Keep research direction aligned with what actually sells, in contact with our supply chain and media buying team.

• Contribute to our documentation and our quality checklists.

• Demonstrate a high level of professionalism at all times.



We will provide you with:

• A two-week onboarding process to set you up for success from the owner and the back end manager

• A well-structured workflow provided at every step of the process including SOP's

• Video call trainings through Zoom

• AI agents that handle the research and listing work, so you spend your time on decisions instead of production

• A salary based on your experience, which we discuss in the interview

• Career growth opportunities within the team



Applicant needs to:

• Speak fluent English both written and verbally.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in product research or listing management for an eCommerce or dropshipping store.

• Be comfortable working with AI output and correcting it. If you expect to do everything manually, this role is not for you.

• Be available for weekly team calls with the back end manager.

• Must be organized, critical, and willing to learn and grow.

• Available to join immediately.

• List every other job or client you currently have, including hours per week. We are fine with it, we are not fine with finding out later.



Hours: the number of hours is based on how many products and stores are in production, so your hours grow as we grow. We explain exactly how this works in the interview. Please indicate how many hours you are available now and how far you could scale up.



As our Research and Listing Manager, you are the quality gate between our AI agents and our customers. Nothing reaches a store without passing through you. Your judgment d
 which products we sell, your eye for detail keeps our catalog and our Google feed clean, and your feedback is what makes the whole system better month after month.

Please respond by telling me what similar experience you have had before and why you think you are a good fit for this job.

In your application, also answer this question: name one product you have seen selling well recently, and tell me the two signals that convinced you it was selling. Please only name a product you have actually checked yourself.



Please apply with the word pineapple before you introduce yourself. Applications that read as AI-generated will not be answered.



I look forward to your proposal.



Thank you.

Jeff

title: Customer Support Manager & VA | E-commerce | Full-Time

We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand looking for an experienced Customer Support Manager & VA to join our team full-time.



This is not an entry-level customer support role.



We’re looking for someone who has strong experience in e-commerce customer support, understands Shopify and e-commerce operations deeply, and is capable of managing a small customer support team of 2-3 people.



You should be someone who works thoroughly, pays close attention to detail, communicates clearly and takes ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



\- Strong experience in e-commerce customer support  

\- Experience managing or supervising a small customer support team  

\- Very good understanding of Shopify and e-commerce operations  

\- Excellent spoken and written English  

\- Extremely reliable and communicative  

\- Strong attention to detail and ability to work thoroughly  

\- Organised and able to keep a clear overview of multiple ongoing tasks  

\- Able to work independently and take ownership  

\- Comfortable communicating with customers, suppliers and team members  

\- Experience with Commslayer is a strong advantage



You should already understand processes such as refunds, cancellations, returns, address changes, tracking issues, product changes, fulfilment problems, subscriptions, chargebacks and general Shopify order management.



YOUR ROLE

\- Making sure tickets are handled correctly and on time

\- Keeping track of refunds, cancellations, order changes and important issues

\- Reporting important issues clearly to the brand owner



We also use AI extensively within our customer support workflow. You should be comfortable using AI while still having enough experience to recognise factual, logical or contextual mistakes before anything is sent to a customer.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We’re specifically looking for someone motivated who wants to grow with the company long term.



As you prove yourself and understand more of the business, the role can expand beyond customer support management.



There is an opportunity to gradually take on more responsibilities, work more closely with the brand owner and potentially become the brand owner’s VA in the future.



As your responsibilities and value to the company increase, there is also significant room for your salary to grow.



COMPENSATION & AVAILABILITY



\- Full-time role  

\- 8 hours per day  

\- Starting pay: $9/hour  

\- Long-term position  

\- Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation over time



We want someone who is looking for a serious long-term opportunity, not someone juggling many different clients at the same time.



WHEN APPLYING

1. How many years you have worked in e-commerce customer support

2. Which e-commerce brands or Shopify stores you have worked with

3. Whether you have previously managed customer support agents, and how many

4. Your experience with Shopify and other customer support tools

5. Whether you have experience with Commslayer

We’re looking for someone experienced, reliable and highly motivated who wants to become an important part of the team, take on more responsibility over time and grow alongside the brand.
