Your main job will be discovering creators across **TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Twitch, and other platforms** who make content around TikTok LIVE, streaming, creator tools, OBS, gaming, tutorials, monetization, and similar topics.



You will then reach out, build partnerships, and get those creators to produce content about BetterTok.



## What You'll Be Doing

- Study creators before reaching out — their views, engagement, audience, content style, hooks, and previous viral videos.

- Identify creators who could naturally make BetterTok content without it feeling like a forced advertisement.

- Contact creators through
, DMs, 
, or other channels.

- Work with creators on content ideas, hooks, angles, and concepts that have a strong chance of performing.

- Make sure creators understand BetterTok enough to demonstrate it correctly.

- Track deadlines and make sure content actually gets posted.

- Track views, engagement, clicks, signups, downloads, and overall campaign performance.

- Identify which creators and content styles perform best.

- Rehire successful creators and build long-term relationships with them.

- Keep an organized list of creators contacted, responses, pricing, deals, content status, expenses, and results.

- Give the BetterTok team regular updates on everything currently in progress.

Examples could include:



**"3 tools every TikTok LIVE streamer needs"**



**"How creators are doing THIS on TikTok LIVE"**



**"How to add custom alerts to your TikTok LIVE"**

**"How to make your TikTok LIVE look professional"**



**"TikTok LIVE features you probably didn't know existed"**

We want creators who can make genuinely useful, entertaining, or interesting content where BetterTok naturally becomes part of the video.

- Is organized enough to manage many creator conversations simultaneously.

- Understands hooks, retention, packaging, and why certain videos outperform others.

- Can look at campaign results and determine what we should do more of.



Experience in **influencer marketing, creator partnerships, creator outreach, UGC, affiliate marketing, or social media growth** is strongly preferred.

Your goal is to consistently find creators capable of making **high-performing BetterTok content** and build a repeatable system where creator videos generate awareness, traffic, and new BetterTok users.



We care about **results**, not simply how many creators are contacted.

We're looking for a 3D Artist / Visualizer to turn our design concepts into stunning, presentation-ready images that showcase the full potential of each space. Speed and photorealistic quality are both essential here: you're creating the first impression of spaces that don't exist yet, and we want that first impression to genuinely delight the people who see it. You'll work closely with our 3D Artist team and our Design team, taking SketchUp models, concept mood boards, and real furniture specs, and turning them into final images that hold up against real product photography. Strong Photoshop finishing skills are essential to this role.



Key Responsibilities 

• Rendering and Visualization: Work from SketchUp scenes, set up lighting, materials, and cameras based on concept mood boards (lighting, ambience, colors, textures), and produce fast raw renders in Vantage or your render engine of choice. 

• Post-Production: Take raw renders to final 4K images in Photoshop: lighting and color balance, material realism, detail enhancement, and entourage, so every image reads as photography, not CG. 

• AI-Assisted Enhancement, With Control: Use current AI tools (upscaling, enhancement, generative edits) to reach realism fast, while keeping furniture, materials, and architecture true to the design. Catch and fix AI hallucinations before anything leaves your desk, and keep every view of the same space consistent. 

• Accuracy to Spec: Make sure furniture and finishes in the final images match the real products: proportions, fabrics, wood grain, metal finishes. Adjust or model pieces when needed. • Team Collaboration: Stay in sync with the 3D Artist team and Design team across concurrent projects, keep assets organized, and flag workflow improvements as you spot them.



What You Bring 

• 4+ years of professional experience in 3D visualization or a related field required, not including school projects, internships, or coursework.

• Strong portfolio of photorealistic interior visualization, ideally with raw vs. final comparisons (please include portfolio link in your cover letter)

• Proven, hands-on skill across the workflow above: SketchUp, a render engine of your choice, and advanced Photoshop finishing 

• A real, current AI-assisted workflow, with a clear method for keeping output accurate 

• Highly organized, able to manage multiple concurrent projects independently 

• Bonus: experience with 3ds Max/Corona and/or furniture modeling from scratch to exact product spec

• DISCOVER: Passion for innovation and continuous learning

• DELIGHT: Commitment to exceptional client experiences



Minimum PC Requirements

• Operating System: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) 

• Graphics Card (most important): NVIDIA RTX GPU with at least 12 GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 3060 12GB). RTX 4070 or better preferred 

• Processor: Intel Core i7 (recent generation) or better 

• Memory (RAM): 32 GB minimum, 64 GB preferred 

• Storage: 1 TB SSD (NVMe preferred) 

• Monitor: Color-accurate display, 1440p or higher; calibrated to sRGB preferred 

• Internet: Stable connection of at least 50 Mbps, with a backup connection (e.g., mobile hotspot) 

• Power backup: UPS recommended, so work isn't lost during outages

, between 3 and 5 minutes. Cover three things: your STR background and the types of operations you have worked for; walk through one specific difficult guest situation you personally handled and how you resolved it; and explain why you are applying to this role. Do not read from a script.

And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Payroll Officer to join our finance team.

-A qualification or relevant studies in Accounting, Finance, Payroll, or a related field.

What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.

The Virtual Executive Administrator takes the logistical and administrative load off the organisation's leaders. You will run diaries, training logistics, documentation, reporting and quality processes with minimal supervision, so that leaders can focus on clients, delivery and growth. You are expected to think ahead, spot what needs doing, and act on it.

Key responsibilities

Diary and meeting management

• Manage leaders' diaries, prioritising commitments and resolving conflicts

• Schedule internal and client meetings, including Teams links, agendas and pre-reads

• Take minutes, record actions and follow up to ensure they are completed

Training programme and workshop logistics

• Manage delegate bookings, joining instructions, reminders and attendance records

• Prepare and distribute workshop books, handouts and course materials

Documentation and presentation

• Format and maintain workshop books, templates and the document library

• Proofread all outgoing material to ensure it is accurate and professionally written

Reporting and governance

• Compile regular management, performance and governance reports

• Prepare board and governance meeting packs, papers and minutes

• Maintain trackers, action logs and registers

ISO 9001 quality management

• Manage the day-to-day running of the ISO 9001 quality management system

• Maintain document control, records and version management

• Coordinate internal audits, corrective actions and management reviews

• Prepare for and support external surveillance and recertification audits

Communication and liaison

• Act as the first point of contact for the leadership team, both internally and with clients

• Liaise with team members on behalf of leaders, following up on deadlines and deliverables

• Communicate professionally with clients in writing, by phone and on video calls

Digital delivery and AI

• Make full use of Microsoft 365, especially Teams, Bookings, Outlook, SharePoint and OneDrive

• Use Microsoft Copilot and Claude to speed up drafting, summarising, research and reporting, applying sound judgement and checking AI output for accuracy

• Recommend and introduce new tools and ways of working that improve online and digital delivery

• Handle confidential and client data securely, in line with UK GDPR and company policy

General office and housekeeping

• Keep shared drives, inboxes and systems organised and up to date

• Maintain contact lists, CRM records and supplier details

• Take on other administrative tasks as needed to support the leadership team

Person specification

Essential

• Excellent written English, with perfect spelling, grammar and punctuation

• Clear, articulate spoken English and a confident telephone and video manner

• Proven experience in an executive assistant, virtual assistant or senior administrative role

• Advanced skills in Microsoft 365, especially Teams and Bookings

• Practical, regular use of AI tools including Microsoft Copilot, and familiarity with Claude

• Strong document design and presentation skills in Word and PowerPoint

• Excellent organisation, timekeeping and attention to detail

• Ability to work on your own initiative and take full ownership of tasks

• A forward-thinking approach, anticipating needs before you are asked

• Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information

• A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and availability during UK business hours

Desirable

• Experience of ISO 9001 or another quality management standard

• Experience coordinating training programmes, events or online learning

• Experience preparing governance or board reports

• Familiarity with project management or automation tools such as Planner, Power Automate or similar

Personal qualities

You are calm, dependable and proactive. You take pride in high standards, communicate clearly and are a genuine team player. Above all, you make leaders' lives easier: you take ownership, run with things and become an asset the organisation relies on.

Measures of success

• Leaders' diaries run smoothly, with no missed or double-booked meetings

• Training programmes and workshops are delivered on time, with all logistics and materials in place

• Reports and documents are accurate, well presented and delivered on deadline

• The ISO 9001 system is current and audit-ready at all times

• Leaders spend measurably less time on administration

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER - CLEANING SERVICES
description:
# Business Development Manager (BDM) – Cleaning Services



## Role Overview



We are looking for a proactive and results-driven **Business Development Manager (BDM)** to drive new business growth and develop long-term client relationships within the cleaning services industry.



The role will focus primarily on **business development, outbound sales, lead generation, client acquisition, quoting, relationship management, and recurring contract growth**, while also supporting operational coordination to ensure a smooth client experience.



The ideal candidate will be confident with outbound sales, comfortable speaking with business decision-makers, commercially minded, and capable of taking a lead from initial prospecting through to quote, conversion, and ongoing relationship management.



## Key Responsibilities



### Business Development & New Client Acquisition



* Identify and develop new business opportunities across commercial, residential, aged care, NDIS, property management, real estate, and other relevant sectors.

* Build targeted prospect lists and identify key decision-makers.

* Conduct consistent outbound cold calling,
, SMS, and other sales outreach.

* Prospect aged care providers, retirement villages, property managers, real estate agencies, strata managers, offices, medical centres, schools, childcare centres, construction companies, and other commercial businesses.

* Qualify prospects based on service requirements, location, frequency, budget, and start date.

* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.

* Generate meetings, site inspections, quote opportunities, and new client accounts.

* Re-engage inactive prospects, previous enquiries, and former clients.

* Identify opportunities for recurring contracts and long-term partnerships.

* Develop referral and strategic partnership opportunities.



### Sales & Lead Conversion



* Manage prospects through the full sales cycle from initial contact to conversion.

* Conduct discovery conversations to understand client requirements and pain points.

* Present suitable cleaning services and service packages.

* Prepare proposals and quotations based on client requirements.

* Follow up consistently on outstanding quotes and opportunities.

* Negotiate pricing within approved company margins.

* Overcome objections and convert qualified opportunities into customers.

* Maintain accurate records of sales activity, opportunities, negotiations, and outcomes.



### Quotes & Pricing



* Prepare and send cleaning quotes based on property size, scope, frequency, location, labour requirements, and special requirements.

* Estimate labour hours and consider cleaner availability, travel, supplies, and equipment when preparing quotes.

* Respond promptly to quote requests received through phone,
, website, social media, and other channels.

* Coordinate site inspections when required.

* Review existing client pricing when service requirements change.

* Maintain accurate pricing and quote records.



### Client Relationship Management



* Build strong relationships with decision-makers and key client contacts.

* Maintain regular communication with new and recurring clients.

* Ensure clients receive timely and professional responses.

* Follow up after initial services to confirm satisfaction.

* Handle client concerns and coordinate appropriate resolutions.

* Identify opportunities to upsell or expand services.

* Re-engage paused or cancelled clients.

* Request reviews and referrals from satisfied customers.

* Develop long-term relationships that support retention and recurring revenue.



### B2B Business Development



#### Aged Care & Community Care



* Build targeted databases of aged care and community care organisations.

* Identify facility managers, operations managers, procurement contacts, and other decision-makers.

* Conduct outbound sales campaigns.

* Introduce cleaning services and identify recurring service opportunities.

* Arrange meetings and site inspections.

* Develop long-term commercial partnerships.



#### Property Management & Real Estate



* Build relationships with property management companies and real estate agencies.

* Identify property managers and relevant business decision-makers.

* Promote end-of-lease, bond cleaning, regular property cleaning, and maintenance cleaning services.

* Develop recurring referral opportunities.

* Identify high-volume property management accounts.

* Work towards preferred-supplier relationships.



#### Commercial Clients



* Prospect offices, medical centres, gyms, retail businesses, schools, childcare centres, warehouses, construction companies, and other commercial properties.

* Identify purchasing and operational decision-makers.

* Conduct targeted outbound campaigns.

* Arrange consultations and site inspections.

* Prepare customised commercial cleaning proposals.

* Negotiate and close recurring cleaning contracts.



### Sales Pipeline & CRM Management



* Maintain an accurate and up-to-date CRM and sales pipeline.

* Record calls,
s, follow-ups, quotes, negotiations, and outcomes.

* Track pending quotes and follow-up dates.

* Maintain prospect and customer databases.

* Monitor opportunities through each stage of the sales process.

* Track new leads, qualified leads, quotes issued, jobs won, and conversion rates.

* Identify where prospects are dropping out of the sales process.

* Maintain a consistent pipeline of future opportunities.



### Operational Coordination & Client Support



* Coordinate with the operations team to ensure new clients can be serviced effectively.

* Confirm cleaner availability before committing to new bookings.

* Support cleaner scheduling when required.

* Communicate client requirements, access instructions, and special requirements to the relevant team.

* Assist with resolving scheduling conflicts and service issues.

* Coordinate replacement cleaners when required.

* Monitor job completion and escalate missed or incomplete services.

* Ensure commitments made during the sales process are communicated clearly to operations.



### Sales Documentation & Process Development



* Prepare client service agreements and scopes of work.

* Maintain sales templates, proposals, capability statements, and follow-up sequences.

* Assist with developing sales SOPs and processes.

* Maintain structured sales scripts and outreach campaigns.

* Support development of client onboarding documentation.

* Keep sales and operational documentation organised and up to date.



### Marketing & Lead Generation



* Assist with targeted sales and lead-generation campaigns.

* Research new industries and potential customer segments.

* Develop targeted prospect databases.

* Prepare cold-call scripts and
 campaigns.

* Develop lead follow-up sequences.

* Identify networking and partnership opportunities.

* Research competitors and monitor market pricing.

* Assist with promotional campaigns and service packages.



## KPIs & Performance Measures



The BDM will be measured primarily on:



* New leads generated

* Outbound calls and sales activities

* Qualified opportunities

* Meetings and site inspections generated

* Quotes issued

* Quote conversion rate

* New clients acquired

* Recurring contracts secured

* Monthly recurring revenue

* Revenue growth

* Sales pipeline value

* Follow-up completion

* Client retention

* Upselling and cross-selling

* Referral and partnership opportunities

* Customer satisfaction



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a **results-driven BDM with strong outbound sales and relationship-building skills** who is comfortable generating business rather than relying solely on inbound enquiries.



You should be confident speaking with business owners, property managers, facility managers, operations managers, and other decision-makers, and be able to take ownership of the sales process from prospecting through to conversion.



### Must-Have Skills



* Proven experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Sales Development, or a similar role.

* Strong cold calling and outbound sales experience.

* Demonstrated ability to generate and convert leads.

* Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Strong client relationship management skills.

* Experience managing a sales pipeline or CRM.

* Strong follow-up and organisation skills.

* Ability to work towards sales targets and KPIs.

* Commercially minded with a focus on revenue generation.

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.

* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.



### Preferred Experience



* Experience in the cleaning, facilities management, property services, maintenance, NDIS, aged care, or home-care sectors.

* Experience selling recurring service contracts.

* Experience working with property managers, real estate agencies, aged care providers, or commercial businesses.

* Experience preparing service quotes.

* Experience coordinating with field-based service teams.

* Experience in the Australian market.



## Working Style



The successful candidate should be:



* Highly proactive and sales-driven

* Confident and persuasive

* Comfortable with cold calling

* Persistent with follow-ups

* Commercially focused

* Target and KPI oriented

* Strong at relationship building

* Highly organised

* Customer focused

* Able to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously

* Comfortable working independently

* Capable of collaborating closely with operations to ensure successful client delivery

title: Head of Marketing (FullTime, Remote) — Own the Strategy, Not Just the To-Do List
description:
⚠️ Please read first: This is NOT a social media manager role. We are not accepting applicants whose experience is primarily in social media management (SMM). We're hiring a strategic marketing leader — please only apply if that's you.



Head of Marketing (Fulltime) — Own the Strategy, Not Just the To-Do List



Most marketing hires wait to be told what to post.

We're looking for the opposite: an experienced marketing leader who walks in asking:



"Is our marketing actually working?"

"Where are we getting real ROI?"

"What should we stop doing tomorrow?"

"Where should we invest more — and why?"



If those are the questions you ask before anyone asks you, keep reading.



Who we are

We're the American Academy of Estate Planning Attorneys (AAEPA), a U.S.-based organization that helps attorneys grow their law firms through membership, training, and strategic education. We're established, we're growing, and we're ready for a senior marketing mind to help us grow smarter.



The role

This is a fulltime, remote, high-trust marketing leadership role. You won't be handed a checklist. You'll be handed the whole marketing ecosystem and asked to make sense of it. We need someone who can look at everything we're doing, dig into the numbers, and tell us — with confidence — what's working, what isn't, why, and what we do next.



What you'll own



- Audit our current marketing and determine what's actually producing results.

- Build and monitor tracking so we can measure campaign performance and ROI with confidence.

- Recommend where to invest, cut, or reallocate the marketing budget.

- Analyze our CRM, contact database, lifecycle stages, funnels, and attribution.

- Spot growth opportunities we're missing.

- Deliver a focused 30/60/90-day plan built around high-impact activities.



What you bring

- Senior-level B2B marketing experience — ideally as a CMO, marketing director, or senior marketing leader.

- Comfort living in the metrics: ROI, conversion rates, attribution, CAC, budgets.

- Real command of CRMs, funnels,
 marketing, automation, and analytics.

- The judgment to work independently, prioritize ruthlessly, and make smart calls with limited hours.

- Excellent written English and clear, confident communication.



Big bonus if you've worked with membership organizations, professional associations, coaching, training, education, or other longer-sales-cycle business models.



This is a great fit if you…

- Love figuring things out.

- Don't need to be managed hour by hour.

- Can comfortably say, "This isn't working, and here's why."

- Know how to turn data into decisions.

- Want real, visible impact on a growing organization.



This is NOT a fit if you're an executor looking for tasks to check off, or if your background is primarily social media management. We have people for execution. We need someone to own the strategy.



How to apply (please read — this matters):



Don't send a generic application. In your reply, tell us:

- One marketing program you audited or ran where you changed the decision based on the data — what did you find, and what did you recommend?

- The tools/CRMs and analytics stacks you know best.

- Your availability (hours/week) and your expected rate.



Applications that follow these three steps go to the top of our list. Applications that don't, we skip.



If this sounds like you — or someone you rate highly — apply or share it with them.

title: Part-Time Video Production & Social Media Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Company: Oxford Management Consultancy (OMC) & RHK Properties

Job Type: Part-Time (20–25 hours/week)

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Opportunity: Long-term, with potential to become full-time



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Video Production & Social Media Coordinator to manage our growing content production and publishing operations across two international brands.



We produce a high volume of long-form YouTube videos, Shorts, Reels, and social media content in multiple languages.



We already work with content creators, video editors, and designers. Your responsibility will be to coordinate everyone, ensure high-quality and timely deliveries, and manage the process from raw footage to published content.



Our goal is simple: We want someone who takes ownership of daily content operations without requiring constant supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Video Production & Editor Management



Maintain a centralized tracker of every video and its production status.



Track videos awaiting assignment, editing, revisions, approval, and publishing.



Assign projects to editors based on workload, capability, quality, and cost.



Find, evaluate, and negotiate with freelance video editors when needed.



Negotiate competitive per-video rates while maintaining quality.



Follow up with editors and enforce agreed deadlines.



Ensure no videos are forgotten, duplicated, or assigned to multiple editors a
.



2. Video Quality Control



Watch completed videos before submitting them for final approval.



Compare edited videos against reference videos and production instructions.



Check storytelling, pacing, hooks, B-roll, graphics, animations, subtitles, audio, and color grading.



Identify missing sections, incorrect information, poor editing, and other quality issues.



Provide editors with clear, timestamped revision instructions.



Ensure editors complete revisions properly before requesting approval.



Minimize the number of videos requiring management intervention.



3. Creator & Content Coordination



Coordinate with English, Spanish, Portuguese, and other international content creators.



Provide creators with approved scripts, guidelines, and recording instructions.



Track recording schedules, raw footage submissions, and deadlines.



Ensure files and instructions are properly organized.



Coordinate between creators, editors, and designers.



4. Social Media Publishing



Schedule and publish approved content across YouTube, Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.



Prepare SEO-friendly YouTube titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, and thumbnails for approval.



Upload YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and other short-form content.



Ensure correct captions, hashtags, thumbnails, links, and formatting.



Maintain a consistent publishing calendar for both brands.



Verify that published content is correctly formatted and live.



5. Reporting & Organization



Maintain an accurate content production dashboard.



Track editor performance, turnaround times, revisions, and production costs.



Provide daily progress updates and a weekly summary.



Identify bottlenecks and proactively resolve problems.



Suggest ways to improve production speed, quality, and efficiency.



Requirements



Experience coordinating video editors, creators, or digital content production.



Strong understanding of YouTube videos, Reels, and Shorts.



Ability to recognize professional video editing versus poor-quality editing.



Excellent written English and communication skills.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Experience with project management tools such as Trello, ClickUp, Notion, or similar.



Comfortable managing freelancers, deadlines, and multiple projects simultaneously.



Familiarity with YouTube Studio, Meta Business Suite, and social media scheduling tools.



Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve productivity.



Important: You do NOT need to be a professional video editor or graphic designer. However, you must understand video production well enough to evaluate quality and communicate effective feedback.



Experience coordinating multilingual content is a plus. Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is not required.



What Success Looks Like



Every video has a clearly assigned owner and deadline.



Editors consistently deliver videos meeting our quality standards.



Videos move efficiently from raw footage to publication.



The content pipeline remains organized and up to date.



Approved content is published consistently.



Management spends significantly less time chasing editors, reviewing avoidable mistakes, and handling routine production issues.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



Have you previously managed video editors or YouTube content production? Describe your experience.



How would you track 50+ videos at different stages of production?



How would you evaluate an editor's work and communicate revisions?



Which project management and social media scheduling tools have you used?



What is your expected monthly salary for 20–25 hours per week?



Please share examples of YouTube channels or social media accounts you have helped manage.



Start your application with the word "PRODUCTION" so we know you read the complete job description.



We are looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, resourceful, and interested in building a long-term working relationship.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper (Xero & Zoho Books) –
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper – Xero & Zoho Books (Remote, UK hours)



Half a day every two weeks · UK business hours · USD $5–$6 per hour (contracted)



Do you take real pride in a perfectly reconciled ledger? We're looking for a meticulous, Xero-proficient bookkeeper to keep our books accurate, up to date and ready for decision-making, half a day every two weeks.

You'll own our day-to-day bookkeeping in Xero and Zoho Books, from processing bills and invoices to matching every bank-feed transaction to the right bill, invoice or nominal account. Xero does the reporting; your accuracy makes it right.



What you'll be doing

• Reconciling bank, credit card and payment accounts in Xero and Zoho Books

• Coding and posting transactions to the correct nominal accounts

• Processing sales invoices, supplier bills, receipts and expenses

• Managing debtors and creditors, and flagging overdue items

• Running Xero's standard monthly reports for the leadership team

• Running month-end checks and keeping the ledgers clean and audit-ready



What you'll bring

• Complete, hands-on proficiency in Xero (Xero certification preferred)

• Confident, accurate use of Zoho Books

• Proven experience of bank reconciliation and payment allocation in Xero

• Sound knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping and nominal ledger structure

• Exceptional attention to detail and a diligent, methodical approach

• Clear written and spoken English

• Availability for half a day every two weeks during UK business hours



Nice to have

• Experience with UK bookkeeping, VAT returns and Making Tax Digital

• An AAT, ICB or similar bookkeeping qualification

• Experience with receipt-capture tools such as Dext or Hubdoc



How to apply

Send your CV and a short cover note telling us how long you've used Xero and Zoho Books, and how you approach a month-end close. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short practical Xero task.



Job description

Detail



Job title

Part-Time Bookkeeper (Xero & Zoho Books)

Reports to

[Managing Director / Finance lead]

Location

Remote

Working hours

Half a day (4 hours) every two weeks, within 9am–5pm UK time (GMT/BST); day to be agreed

Contract

Contracted, part-time

Rate

USD $5–$6 per hour (approx. $45–$52 per month), depending on experience



Purpose of the role



The Part-Time Bookkeeper keeps the organisation's financial records complete, accurate and up to date in Xero and Zoho Books. You will reconcile accounts, post every transaction to the correct nominal account, so that Xero's built-in reports give leaders an accurate, up-to-date picture of the business.

Key responsibilities



Xero bookkeeping

• Operate Xero confidently across all core functions, including bank feeds, bank rules, invoicing, bills and reporting

• Match bank-feed transactions to the correct bills, invoices and payments, and reconcile all accounts every two weeks

• Code and post all transactions to the correct nominal accounts and tracking categories

• Maintain the chart of accounts, contacts and bank rules, keeping them clean and consistent

• Investigate and resolve unreconciled items, duplicates and suspense balances



Zoho Books bookkeeping

• Apply the same standard of diligence in Zoho Books, including reconciliations, coding and reporting

• Keep records consistent between Xero and Zoho Books where entities or processes overlap

Sales and purchase ledgers

• Raise and process sales invoices and record customer receipts

• Process supplier bills and expenses, prepare payments, and allocate each payment to the correct bill

• Monitor aged debtors and creditors and flag overdue or disputed items

Month-end and reporting

title: Paint Our Kits at Home + Film Quiet ASMR iPhone Video (Paid Per Painting)
description:
Work from home. We ship the paint by numbers kits to you free. Paid per painting, not per hour.



We are a US paint-by-numbers wall art brand. We need one person to paint our kits at home and film the painting as quiet ASMR style video on an iPhone. No talking, no music, no face. Just hands, daylight, and the sound of the brush.



This is steady ongoing work, not a one-off. Start at 2 to 4 paintings a week. If the work is good we grow it and keep it running long term.



WHAT WE PAY FOR (one flat rate per painting covers all three)

1. The finished painting, neat, all numbers filled.

2. One edited vertical video, 15 to 60 seconds.

3. All the raw footage, delivered in full. We own all the footage.

You keep the finished painting.



REQUIREMENTS

- iPhone. Vertical 9:16. Sharp focus. No filters.

- Phone on a tripod or overhead stand, never handheld. Multiple Angles, showcasing progress on painting from start to finish. 

- Daylight only. Bright soft light from a window. No ring lights, no yellow bulbs, no night filming.

- Clean sound: brush on canvas, paint pots clicking open, stirring, brush rinsing. Quiet room, no talking, no music.

- Looks like a home, not a studio. Clean wooden or plain table. Minimal props.

- Women's hands only. Clean nails. No heavy jewelry.

- Four checkpoint shots every painting, same framing each time: start (blank canvas with paints laid out), halfway, three quarters, fully finished plus one reveal shot. Lots of broll of ASMR style content with the paint, brushes, close ups of brush painting on the canvas. 

- Continuous painting footage in between at close, medium, and wide angles.

- Deliver on Google Drive or Dropbox, one folder per painting, within 7 days of the kit arriving.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with two things. Applications missing either one will be skipped.

1. Your rate per painting in USD, all three deliverables included.

2. A link to one 20 to 60 second clip of you painting anything by a window in daylight with clean audio. It does not have to be one of our kits.



We will pick 2 to 3 finalists and pay each for one trial painting before we choose.

title: Direct-Response Copywriter | VSLs & Affiliate Video Ads
description:
We're an affiliate marketing agency looking for a direct-response copywriter who can uncover fresh buying angles and turn audience research into persuasive video scripts. You'll work with media buyers and video editors to create, test and improve ads for nutra, telehealth, money/finance and other affiliate offers.



This is an ongoing, part-time role: US$600/month for 20 hours/week, plus performance commissions on winning creatives.



WHAT YOU'LL WRITE

- Video sales letters (VSLs), mini-VSLs and short-form direct-response affiliate video ads.

- Original hooks, buying angles, stories, proof sections, objection handling and calls to action.

- Clear creative briefs for editors, including opening visuals, scenes, on-screen text and pacing.



HOW YOU'LL WORK

- Research the audience, offer, competitors and customer language. Understand what people want, what they believe and what holds them back from buying.

- Use those insights to propose original angles and explain why each could resonate with the audience.

- Work with buyers to choose test priorities, review real campaign feedback and improve the next scripts.

- Keep scripts, briefs and revisions organized so editors and buyers can act on them.



WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong written English and relevant direct-response copywriting experience, especially video ads, VSLs or affiliate offers.

- Good audience insight, storytelling and persuasive structure.

- The ability to explain your creative decisions and take ownership from research through iteration.

- Reliable communication and availability for 20 hours per week.



Experience with nutra, telehealth or money/finance offers is helpful. AI tools can support your process; your own research, judgment and original creative thinking are essential.



Use accurate, supported health and financial claims and appropriate disclosures. Flag unsupported or restricted claims before production. No fabricated testimonials, results, medical claims or earnings promises.



PAY

- US$600 per month for 20 hours per week.

- Additional performance commissions on winning creatives. The definition of a winner, attribution, commission calculation and payment terms will be agreed before starting. Commissions depend on results and are not guaranteed.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with VSL600 as the first word, then send:

1. Links to 2–3 existing relevant scripts, VSLs, mini-VSLs or video ads. Briefly say what you personally wrote and label each as live campaign work or an untested concept.

2. For one sample, explain the audience insight and angle in a few sentences. Include results if available and permitted, with enough context to understand them; say whether you verified them yourself or they were reported by a client/team. It's fine if results aren't available.

3. Confirm that US$600/month for 20 hours/week works for you, your usual working hours/timezone and earliest start date.



Keep it short. Existing work is enough; no new unpaid sample is required to apply. Only share work you have permission to disclose and redact confidential details.

title: Guest Experience Specialist – Short-Term Rentals (Overnight, AI-Savvy)
description:
THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• US$4-8 per hour, based on demonstrated ability and verified experience; your rate is agreed before training starts

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

title: Part-Time B2B SDR | Paid Training | $480/Month Base + Commissions | Leads, CRM & Dialer Provided
description:
Build a real path into B2B sales—with qualified leads, a CRM, proven scripts, structured training, call coaching, and a professional U.S. dialer already provided.



EditValue provides premium wedding-video post-production for wedding photographers and studios. We are hiring a confident English-speaking SDR to introduce our service to U.S. wedding businesses and help them try a complimentary wedding reel.



Why this role is worth your time:

• You do not need to find your own leads

• We provide the CRM, dialer, sales playbook, scripts, training materials, and coaching

• Every call is recorded so you can receive specific feedback and improve

• Our Local Presence system displays a clean local U.S. caller ID matching the prospect’s area code, which can improve answer rates

• There is a clear paid path from training to live calls and long-term work

• Base pay plus uncapped commissions rewards both consistency and results



Schedule:

• Monday–Friday only; no weekend calling

• 9:00 AM–1:00 PM in the local U.S. time zone assigned to your leads

• Four consecutive hours per day

• This normally means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines, depending on the assigned U.S. territory



Your responsibilities:

• Make 200 calls per day during your four-hour calling shift (50 calls per hour), both during the live trial and regular work

• Speak naturally and confidently with wedding photographers and studio owners

• Explain EditValue clearly and offer one complimentary wedding reel

• Ask useful questions, identify decision-makers, and follow up with interested studios

• Accurately record dispositions and notes in the CRM

• The key outcome is getting an interested wedding studio to send footage for its complimentary reel



Compensation after successfully completing the live trial:

• $480/month guaranteed base

• $20 for every qualified wedding studio that submits wedding footage

• $70 for every new paying client

• Unlimited commissions



Your clear path into the role:

1. Application review — Send a 30–60 second audio or video recording explaining why you would be strong at cold calling.

2. SDR scenario test — A short, unpaid online assessment showing how you would handle one realistic cold-call scenario.

3. Paid SDR101 preparation — Guided learning and practice so you understand EditValue, the offer, and how to approach prospects.

4. Paid simulated-call training — Complete 25 coached calls across five levels. The session takes two hours or more. We pay $10 through PayPal after full completion.

5. Paid three-day live trial — Four consecutive hours per day, 200 calls per day, paid at $20 per completed day. You will receive the dialer, CRM access, leads, instructions, and feedback.

6. Longer-term opportunity — Strong performers may advance to a paid two-week evaluation, then a full month and ongoing employment. Our goal is a reliable long-term SDR relationship.



Payments during the assessment process are made through PayPal, so you must be able to receive PayPal payments.



Who will do well:

• Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation

• Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners

• Previous B2B, SDR, appointment-setting, or cold-calling experience is preferred

• Coachable, reliable, and willing to apply feedback quickly

• Comfortable working the stated U.S. hours

• Reliable computer, internet connection, and microphone

• Consistent, accurate CRM use



Learn about the service before applying: 



How to apply:

Please include a 30–60 second audio or video recording and explain why you would be great at cold calling.



Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: CLIENT RELATIONSHIP MANAGER - $1,500–$2,000 BASE + BONUSES
description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Get certified in 30–60 days through consistent quality work and leadership approval.



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- You may split your shift

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Attend team/training meetings around 9 PM – 11 PM PH time (when scheduled)

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process - it must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize their brand online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

title: Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor
description:
Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor



Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative Strategist to analyze social media data from posted videos, understand content and marketing on a fundamental level, create raw AI clips, and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is a strategy AND execution role. You’ll be taught from the ground up how to actually think like a creator - not just how to follow instructions.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay. We care much more about having a hunger to learn, strong English, and your ability to improve independently. We'll give you the resources - what you do with them is up to you.



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy & Data

- Analyze the performance of posted videos and understand WHY certain content wins or loses

- Use data to create a feedback loop and continuously improve future videos

- Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, pacing, and creative patterns

- Research competitors, audiences, trends, and high-performing content

- Come to us with what you've learned, what you've changed, and where you need advice - not wait for us to tell you what to do 



Copywriting & Content

- Understand the fundamentals of hooks, storytelling, retention, persuasion, and customer psychology

- Write and improve short-form scripts based on research and performance data

- Identify weaknesses in scripts and creatives before production

- Develop new ideas and angles instead of simply recreating existing content

- Adapt content to different brands, audiences, and niches 



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage and AI-generated assets into high-retention short-form content

- Edit in CapCut with strong pacing, captions, B-roll, overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling

- Develop a strong creative eye and independently identify what needs improvement

- Maintain quality and consistency across multiple client accounts

- Apply feedback quickly and make sure the same mistakes don't keep happening 



AI Content Creation

- Generate AI images, videos, avatars, voices, and other creative assets using our tools

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, and others as part of the creative process

- Experiment with new tools and workflows as AI technology evolves

- Quality check all AI outputs before using them in content

- Learn how to get better outputs instead of relying on us to provide every prompt or solution 



General

- Manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Communicate proactively about progress, ideas, problems, and results

- Take ownership of your work from research to final output

- Constantly look for ways to improve your own skills and the team's content

- Solve problems independently before immediately asking for help 



Requirements



Must-Haves

- EXTREMELY STRONG ENGLISH - WRITTEN, SPOKEN, AND COMPREHENSION

- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!!! 

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Strong WiFi connection with rare occurrences of outages

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- Strong attention to detail and creative quality

- Able to think critically and understand WHY content performs

- Comfortable working with data and using it to improve creative decisions

- Willing to learn copywriting, marketing, AI, editing, and content strategy

- Extremely proactive - you should be coming to us with improvements, not waiting for us to find your mistakes

- Able to research and teach yourself when you don't know something

- Able to take feedback without ego and immediately apply it

- Willing to go above and beyond what is directly assigned

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous agency or content production experience

- Copywriting or direct-response marketing experience

- Experience analyzing social media performance data

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, Kling, or similar tools

- Experience researching competitors, customers, and markets

- Strong understanding of internet culture and social media trends



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Access to all required AI and editing tools

- Copywriting, marketing, editing, and creative strategy resources

- Direct feedback and mentorship on your work

- Access to real performance data so you can understand what actually works

- Freedom to test ideas, experiment, and develop your own creative instincts

- Opportunity to develop skills across editing, AI, copywriting, data analysis, and strategy

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay.



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2-3 of your best short-form content edits

- What AI tools have you used before?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): If one of your videos significantly underperformed compared to the others, how would you figure out what went wrong and improve the next one?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): Tell us about something you taught yourself without being asked. How did you learn it?

- Your timezone + working hours

No portfolio = no review.

Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant to Manager at Financial Services Company



I’m looking for a sharp, organised, and proactive Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant to support me across my financial advisory business, agency operations, client follow-ups, recruitment pipeline, and day-to-day admin.



This role is for someone who is detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable being the person who keeps things moving behind the scenes.



About the role



You will work closely with me to make sure important follow-ups, client servicing, recruitment conversations, appointments, documents, campaigns, and admin tasks do not fall through the cracks.



The ideal person is not just an “admin helper”. I’m looking for someone who can think ahead, organise information clearly, remind me of what matters, and help me create more structure and systems in the business.



Key responsibilities



- Track client and prospect follow-ups

- Maintain sales, recruitment, and servicing pipelines

- Schedule meetings, reviews, and follow-up reminders

- Prepare simple meeting notes and action lists

- Help organise client documents, proposal materials, and onboarding/admin items

- Follow up on pending client/recruitment tasks

- Help manage weekly priorities and checklists

- Coordinate with team members where needed

- Assist with basic content/admin preparation for WhatsApp, broadcast lists, or client updates

- Keep files, records, and trackers neat and updated

- Flag missing information, overdue follow-ups, and bottlenecks proactively



Who I’m looking for



You should be:



- Very organised and detail-oriented

- Proactive - able to remind, chase, and follow through without being micromanaged

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Docs, WhatsApp/Telegram, and basic online tools

- Good with written communication

- Able to handle confidential client/business information maturely

- Calm, reliable, and consistent

- Comfortable working with a fast-moving business owner

- Willing to learn financial advisory/admin processes

- AI knowhow and the ability to leverage on it to cut down time on administrative tasks



Bonus if you have



- Experience supporting financial advisors, insurance agents, property agents, recruiters, or business owners

- Experience with CRM/pipeline tracking

- Experience managing calendars and appointments

- Experience preparing client-facing documents or simple presentations

- Strong English writing skills

- Good sense of urgency without being messy



What this role is not



This is not a passive admin role where you only wait for instructions.



I need someone who can help me create order, remind me of pending items, and make sure opportunities and people are followed up properly.



Working arrangement



- Part-time or full-time can be discussed

- Hybrid/remote possible depending on fit

- Singapore-based preferred

- Pay to be discussed based on experience and scope



To apply



Please send:



1. Your short intro

2. Past work experience

3. Why you think you’re a good fit for this role

4. Your availability

5. Expected pay

EJF is a property management company headquartered in Washington, DC. We are looking for Assistant Property Managers for our growing team. A successful candidate will enjoy solving problems, is responsible, organized, detail oriented, and reliable.



Role Purpose:



The Associate Community Manager (ACM) is responsible for supporting the Community Association Manager (CAM) in the daily operations, financial oversight, administrative functions, and resident/board communications of assigned associations. The ACM ensures timely execution of operational tasks, accurate financial processing, regulatory compliance, and consistent communication, allowing the CAM to focus on strategic management and board leadership.

s, notices, and announcements to residents.

Key/fobs/clickers and entry systems request.



5. Compliance & Regulatory Tracking:

Assist with statutory and jurisdictional requirements, including but not limited to:



Elevator certifications

Energy benchmarking

County registrations

Other jurisdiction-specific filings and inspections

Notify CAM of upcoming deadlines and compliance risks



6. Resale & Homeowner Support:



Assist the resale department by providing additional information and documentation as requested.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely responses to resale-related inquiries.



7. Documentation & Systems Management:



File and maintain accurate records in SharePoint and Vantaca including:



Contracts

Compliance records

Correspondence

Inspection reports

Draft letters

Meeting notices, proxies, and related materials

Forms, service tickets,



Ensure documents are properly stored and accessible in Sharepoint and Vantaca.

Follow standardized folder structures, naming conventions, and document retention guidelines.



Authority & Escalation:



ACMs operate within defined approval limits and SOP guidelines.

Strategic decisions, policy changes, and board-level recommendations are escalated to the CAM.

Issues impacting association risk, budget variance, or legal exposure must be escalated promptly.



Performance Expectations & KPIs:



 and inquiry response time: < 2 business hours.

On-time utility payments and invoice processing.

Accuracy of GL coding and financial reporting.

Compliance deadlines met with no lapses.

SOP adherence and training completion.

Positive feedback from CAMs and boards on responsiveness and reliability.

title: Claude AI Operator for a Shopify Fashion Brand | Build Our Support, Supplier & Reporting Automations
description:
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We run a sub niche fashion brand on Shopify, selling across the Big Five markets, with fulfillment through an agent in China. We are looking for one person who runs our support inbox, keeps our supplier sharp, and builds the AI systems behind both: agents that prepare replies, dashboards and reporting that fill themselves from what comes in, and automations that catch problems before a customer does.



This is a building role with a support inbox attached, not the other way around. We work in Claude. If you have not set up agents, workflows or reporting in Claude yourself, this is not the role for you, however good you are at support.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD



These are the first projects. You will own them.



- An agent that reads incoming customer
s and prepares the reply, so all a human does is check and send

- Dashboards and reporting that build themselves from the inbox: refund reasons, sizing issues, recurring product problems, supplier performance

- A supply check that flags orders sitting still too long and raises it with the agent before the customer writes in

- A product quality guarantee: checks that trigger after a set number of orders to confirm what the supplier ships still meets - our standard, and a clear process when it does not

- A dispute agent that kicks in when a chargeback comes in and gathers the evidence

- Stock alerts so we reach the agent before a product runs out



WHAT YOU WILL RUN



- The support inbox: order questions, tracking, delays, refunds, replacements, sizing, complaints

- Direct communication with our agent in China about orders, stock, quality, replacements and delays, followed through until it is actually solved

- Chargebacks and payment disputes, from gathering evidence to submitting the case

- Reviewing AI drafted replies and catching what the AI gets wrong before it reaches a customer

s does not count.

 alone, and how you catch it when it goes wrong.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Here is a professional, conversion-optimized job description tailored to your software stack and platforms. To respect your preference for keeping operational metrics private from competitors, this draft highlights the technical requirements and scale without disclosing specific order volumes or revenue figures.



Job Title: E-commerce Bookkeeper / Virtual Assistant (Amazon, Walmart, Temu)

Location: Remote

Job Type: Part-Time / Full-Time



 Job Summary

We are a growing, fast-paced multi-channel e-commerce business selling across major marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, and Temu. We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and experienced E-commerce Bookkeeper / Virtual Assistant to manage our daily financial tracking, reconciliation, and inventory reporting.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience handling the unique financial structures of Amazon accounts and must be proficient with e-commerce accounting workflows. Experience with our exact tech stack—specifically Connectbooks and Nineyard—is a significant advantage.



 Key Responsibilities



* Marketplace Reconciliation: Reconcile multi-channel payouts (Amazon settlements, Walmart payments, Temu disbursements) against actual sales, returns, operational fees, and reserves.

* Software Management: Utilize Connectbooks to automate and sync financial data, ensuring clean, accurate transaction tracking down to the item level.

* Inventory & Cost of Goods Sold (COGS): Work alongside our master inventory system (Nineyard) to track inventory value, monitor accounts payable for suppliers, and accurately calculate monthly COGS.

* Financial Reporting: Maintain up-to-date Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, and cash flow tracking.

* Discrepancy Investigation: Identify, audit, and resolve any settlement discrepancies, fee overcharges, or inventory discrepancies from marketplaces.



 Qualifications & Requirements



* Experience: Minimum 2+ years of bookkeeping experience specifically for Amazon sellers (FBA and FBM models). Experience with multi-marketplace environments (Walmart, Temu) is highly preferred.

* Tech Stack: Strong proficiency with Connectbooks is a major plus. Experience working with multi-channel inventory software like Nineyard is highly desirable. Proficient in standard accounting software (QuickBooks Online or Xero).

* E-commerce Knowledge: Deep understanding of Amazon-specific financial concepts, including delayed deposits, A-to-z claim impacts, reserve balances, and automated fee structures.

* Analytical Skills: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with a sharp eye for numbers and data integrity.

* Communication: Strong English communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote setting.



What We Offer



* Competitive compensation based on experience.

* Flexible remote working hours.

* Opportunity for long-term growth as the business expands.



Note: Even if you do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we still encourage you to apply! Please let us know exactly which area or software you are missing in your application, and we can discuss providing a ramp-up period to fill in the gap over your first few weeks.

title: Senior Credit Officer - Bank Experience
description:
About Buildfund



Buildfund is a growing funding business that provides finance solutions to businesses and is entering an exciting period of expansion.



With a significant new funding line secured and additional capital being injected into the business, Buildfund is rapidly building its team to support a major growth push towards the end of the year.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Credit Analyst with a strong banking background to play a key role in assessing credit applications, managing risk, and supporting sound lending decisions.



Senior Credit Analyst

As a Senior Credit Analyst, you will assess the creditworthiness of prospective borrowers and make informed recommendations based on financial information, business performance, credit history, and overall risk profile.



Key Responsibilities

* Assess and analyse credit applications and supporting financial information.

* Review financial statements, bank statements, cash flow, and other relevant documentation.

* Assess borrower financial performance, repayment capacity, and overall risk.

* Identify credit risks, inconsistencies, and potential red flags.

* Prepare clear and well-supported credit recommendations.

* Conduct due diligence and verify information provided by applicants.

* Maintain accurate credit assessment records and documentation.



What We're Looking For

* 3–5 years of experience in credit analysis, credit assessment, or lending.

* Strong banking background, preferably in commercial lending, SME lending, business banking, or credit risk.

* Strong understanding of credit assessment and lending risk.

* Ability to analyze financial statements and assess business financial health.

* Strong understanding of cash flow, debt servicing capacity, profitability, and liquidity.

* Strong communication skills, analytical skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and make sound credit recommendations.



Highly Desirable

* Experience assessing SME or commercial lending applications.

* Experience with business loans, working capital facilities, asset finance, or similar lending products.

* Experience helping develop or improve credit policies and processes.

* Exposure to credit decisioning systems or lending platforms.



What Buildfund Offers

* PHP 50,000–55,000 monthly salary, depending on experience and capability.

* Salary increase after 6 months probation

* HMO coverage after 30 days.

* 5:45 AM – 2:45 PM PH shift.

* Fully remote work.

* Ongoing learning and professional development.

title: Aprinta — Print Purchasing & Order Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Department: Purchasing & Order Operations

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Aprinta Operations



About Aprinta



Aprinta is a growing branded products platform helping businesses manage promotional products, custom apparel, commercial printing, company stores, packaging, kitting and fulfillment.



We are building an operations team that can efficiently manage customer orders from purchase through production and delivery.



We are looking for a Print Purchasing & Order Specialist who can take ownership of commercial printing orders and work directly with our production vendors.



The Position



This is not a basic data-entry or virtual assistant position.



You will be responsible for helping manage Aprinta's commercial print orders from the time an order is approved until the finished product is delivered.



You will work with printers and production partners to obtain pricing, source products, issue purchase orders, coordinate artwork and proofs, track production, solve problems and ensure orders are completed correctly and on time.



The ideal candidate has previous experience in commercial printing, print purchasing, print estimating, print production, procurement or print order management.



Key Responsibilities

Order Management

Review incoming customer orders for completeness and accuracy.

Verify product specifications, quantities, dimensions, materials, finishing requirements, artwork and delivery dates.

Identify missing or conflicting information before production begins.

Assign orders to appropriate production vendors.

Maintain accurate order status throughout the production process.

Track every order from purchase through delivery.

Purchasing & Vendor Management

Request pricing from approved print vendors.

Compare vendor pricing, production capabilities and turnaround times.

Negotiate pricing when appropriate.

Identify the best vendor based on price, quality, capabilities and delivery requirements.

Create and submit purchase orders.

Confirm vendor acknowledgements and pricing.

Maintain accurate vendor pricing information.

Help identify and qualify new production partners.

Develop backup vendors for important product categories.

Print Production



Candidates should understand or be willing to quickly learn common print specifications including:



Paper stocks and weights

Coated and uncoated stocks

Digital printing

Offset printing

Wide-format printing

Signs and banners

Labels and stickers

Packaging

PMS and process color

Bleeds and safe areas

Finishing

Folding

Binding

Lamination

Die cutting

Mailing and fulfillment

Artwork & Proof Management

Submit production-ready artwork to vendors.

Obtain electronic or production proofs.

Compare proofs against the original order.

Verify dimensions, colors, quantities, finishing and other specifications.

Coordinate corrections when required.

Ensure production does not proceed until required approvals are received.

Production & Shipping

Monitor production schedules.

Confirm expected ship dates.

Follow up proactively with vendors.

Identify potential delays before they become customer problems.

Obtain tracking information.

Confirm orders ship to the correct destination.

Escalate urgent production or shipping issues.

Problem Resolution



Take ownership when something goes wrong.



This may include:



Incorrect printing

Damaged products

Quantity shortages

Late production

Incorrect specifications

Shipping problems

Artwork issues

Quality problems



Work with vendors to obtain reprints, credits, refunds or other appropriate resolutions.



Cost & Margin Control

Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders.

Record actual production costs.

Identify pricing discrepancies.

Look for opportunities to reduce purchasing costs.

Help maintain Aprinta's target gross margins.

Continually evaluate whether Aprinta is receiving competitive vendor pricing.

What We're Looking For



Preference will be given to candidates with previous experience working for:



Commercial printers

Printing brokers

Print management companies

Promotional product distributors

Packaging companies

Purchasing departments

Print production departments



You should be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Comfortable managing multiple orders simultaneously

Strong with spreadsheets and web-based systems

Comfortable communicating with U.S. vendors by email and phone

Able to negotiate professionally

Comfortable working independently

Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

Able to identify problems and escalate them quickly

Success in This Role



You will be measured on:



Order accuracy

On-time production and delivery

Purchasing savings

Gross-margin protection

Order turnaround time

Vendor performance

Error rate

Problem resolution

Accuracy of order records

Number of orders requiring management intervention



Our goal is simple:



Once an order is assigned to you, you own it until it is successfully delivered.



How to Apply



Please include:



A summary of your relevant experience.

Any commercial printing experience you have.

The types of printed products you have purchased or managed.

Your experience obtaining and comparing vendor quotes.

Your experience issuing purchase orders.

Your experience reviewing artwork or print proofs.

The software or order-management systems you have used.

Your current availability.

Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.



Please begin your application with the words “PRINT OPERATIONS” so we know you carefully reviewed the position.
