title: Wildlife Photography Editer
description:
I’m a UK-based wildlife photographer who travels around the world photographing animals in the wild, on safaris and in wildlife parks.



I’m looking for a talented, reliable photo editor to help me take my wildlife photography to the next level.



This is NOT a general photo editing position.



I’m specifically looking for somebody who has experience editing wildlife and animal photography, understands how to bring out the best in animal subjects, and has an exceptional eye for detail.



My photographs include everything from big cats and elephants to birds, marine wildlife and other animals photographed in different environments and lighting conditions.



The edited images will initially be used on a growing wildlife-focused social media account, with longer-term plans to develop a range of photography products, including prints, calendars and potentially other merchandise.



I’m looking for somebody who would enjoy being involved in this journey long term, rather than simply completing a few edits.



What I’m looking for



You MUST have strong experience using both:



* Adobe Lightroom / Lightroom Classic

* Adobe Photoshop



Advanced masking skills are absolutely essential.



I want somebody who can look at a wildlife photograph and understand exactly which adjustments will improve it without making the animal or environment look unnatural.



For example, you should be confident with:



* Advanced subject and background masking

* Precisely masking animals, including difficult areas such as fur, feathers, whiskers and fine details

* Selectively adjusting exposure, shadows and highlights

* Enhancing animal eyes naturally without making them look artificial

* Improving fur, feather and skin detail

* Managing noise in photographs taken at high ISO

* Sharpening wildlife images without introducing unwanted artefacts

* Adjusting colours while maintaining realistic animal appearances

* Improving distracting backgrounds without making them look fake

* Removing minor distractions where appropriate

* Creating consistent edits across a collection of photographs

* Using Photoshop for more advanced corrections where Lightroom alone isn’t sufficient



I particularly value editors who understand that sometimes the best editing is subtle editing.



I’m not looking for oversaturated colours, excessive sharpening, artificial-looking eyes or photographs that have been edited beyond recognition.



The animals should remain the focus of the image.



Wildlife photography experience is essential



Please only apply if you have genuine experience editing wildlife or animal photography.



Experience editing portraits, weddings, landscapes, products or general social media photographs is not enough on its own.



Wildlife photography presents different challenges, particularly when dealing with:



* Animals photographed in difficult lighting conditions

* Busy natural backgrounds

* Fast-moving subjects

* Fine feather and fur details

* High ISO images

* Subjects partially hidden by vegetation

* Maintaining realistic colours and textures



I want somebody who understands these challenges and enjoys working with wildlife images.



You don’t necessarily need to be a wildlife photographer yourself, but you should understand what makes a strong wildlife photograph.



What the work will involve



Initially, I expect to need approximately 2 hours of editing per week.



I will provide the original RAW photographs, along with occasional guidance on the style or finish I’m looking for.



Your responsibilities will include:



1. Selecting and applying appropriate adjustments in Lightroom.

2. Using detailed masking to improve subjects and backgrounds independently.

3. Using Photoshop where more advanced editing is required.

4. Producing polished, high-quality images suitable for Instagram and
.

5. Maintaining a consistent, natural editing style.

6. Exporting photographs in the requested formats and resolutions.

7. Keeping the original RAW files untouched and providing editable files when requested.

8. Communicating clearly and meeting agreed deadlines.



I would also welcome suggestions about how individual photographs could be improved.



I’m not looking for somebody who simply applies the same preset to every image.



Long-term opportunities



Although this position will begin with approximately 2 hours per week, I’m hoping to build a long-term working relationship with the right person.



As the social media account continues to grow, there is potential for additional editing hours and more regular work.



My longer-term ambition is to sell wildlife photography prints, calendars and other photography products.



If this becomes successful, I would be very happy to discuss a profit-sharing arrangement with the editor who has helped develop the images and contributed to the project’s success.



This would be separate from the agreed hourly payment and would be something we discuss properly as the project develops.



I’d love to find somebody who is genuinely interested in wildlife photography and would enjoy seeing their work contribute to something that grows over time.



How to apply – please read carefully



I receive a lot of applications, so I’ve included some specific instructions to help identify people who have taken the time to read the full advert.



Your application MUST begin with the word “mask” (all lowercase).



It must be the very first word of your application.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.



Please then include the following:



1. Introduce yourself



Tell me a little about yourself, your editing background and why you’re interested in working specifically with wildlife photography.



2. Show me your wildlife editing experience



Please provide a portfolio containing at least 3–5 examples of wildlife or animal photographs you have personally edited.



I would strongly prefer to see BEFORE and AFTER versions so I can understand exactly what improvements you made.



General portrait, wedding or product editing portfolios will not be sufficient.



3. Explain your masking experience



Tell me about your experience using masking in Lightroom and Photoshop.



In particular, explain how you would approach editing an animal with fine fur or feathers against a complicated background.



I want to understand your actual editing process, not just read a list of software features.



4. Tell me about your editing workflow



Do you use Lightroom Classic, Lightroom, Photoshop or a combination?



How do you move between the programmes, and what types of adjustments do you prefer to complete in each?



5. Explain your approach to natural-looking wildlife photography



How do you enhance an animal’s eyes, detail and colours without making the photograph look overedited?



Please give a specific example from your own editing experience.



6. Confirm your availability



Please confirm that you are comfortable starting with approximately 2 hours per week at $6.88 USD per hour, with the possibility of increasing hours over time.



7. Include the word “feathers”



Somewhere in your answer to question 5, please naturally include the word “feathers”.



This is simply another way for me to see that you have read the instructions carefully.



Next stage – practical editing test



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small practical editing task using one of my own wildlife RAW photographs.



The task will be designed to assess:



* Lightroom and Photoshop ability

* Precision of masking

* Natural colour correction

* Eye for detail

* Understanding of wildlife photography

* Overall quality of the finished image



I will provide the same photograph to shortlisted applicants so I can compare editing styles fairly.



Full details will be shared with those selected.



Finally



I’m looking for somebody who takes pride in their work, notices the small details and genuinely enjoys editing photographs of animals.



If you love wildlife photography, have excellent Lightroom and Photoshop skills, and would like to become part of a growing project, I’d really like to hear from you.



Please make sure you follow ALL the application instructions.



I look forward to seeing your work.

title: Experienced Shopify E-commerce Customer Service & Sales Associate – High-Ticket Backyard Products (US Store)

About us

We are a fast-growing US online store selling high-end backyard products: water features, fire features, and fire and water features. Our customers are homeowners, landscapers, designers and builders across the United States. Most of our orders are between $1,000 and $15,000, so customers want to talk to a real person before they buy.

We are a small, friendly team that works together to look after every customer. You will have teammates to learn from and lean on, and you will be trusted to take ownership of your work.

.

The role

We are looking for the voice of our store. You will answer the phone, talk to customers about our products, help them choose the right one, and turn their questions into orders. You will also keep customers and suppliers updated by
 until every order is delivered.

This is a customer service and sales role. You will not be creating products or doing data entry.

BPO and call center experience does not count for this role

.

The ideal person

People person: warm, kind, patient and a good listener. You make every customer feel heard and cared for.

Accountable and self-driven: you own your work, keep yourself on track without reminders, and when something goes wrong, you fix it and tell us what happened.

Proactive and resourceful: you don't wait to be told. You find the answer yourself, using everything available: our product pages, training manuals and installation guides, Google and AI tools, or a call or
 to the manufacturer.

Knowledgeable: you get to know our products in depth, so you can explain the details clearly and recommend the right product for each customer's space and needs.

Follows through: if a customer needs help, you stay with it until it is solved

Speaks up: asks questions and tells us when something could be better

Coachable: comfortable with direct, respectful feedback

.

You will become a product expert

Our products are technical, and customers call us because they want an expert. You will be expected to learn our products in detail, so you can answer customer questions with confidence and recommend the right product for each customer's space, budget and setup.

That includes knowing:

How each product is built: materials (cast stone, concrete, copper, corten and stainless steel, bronze), sizes, weights and finishes

Fire features: natural gas vs propane, ignition types (match lit, electronic, remote and app control), burners, and what the customer needs for their gas line

Water features: pumps, water flow, basins, electrical needs (outdoor outlet), and winter care

Installation and delivery: level ground and foundations, freight delivery, and what the customer must prepare

Lead times: which products are made to order and how long they take

You will get training, and you can always refer to product pages, spec sheets and installation manuals to get the right answers. You don't need to memorize them.

When you don't know an answer, you find out. You never guess. You check the spec sheet, ask the team, or contact the manufacturer, and then you get back to the customer when you said you would.

.

What you will do

Answer phone calls from customers, and call back leads and missed calls

Drive sales: follow up on every lead (quote requests, inquiries and abandoned carts) until the customer d
, help them choose the right product, send quotes, and take orders over the phone

Answer product technical questions and make recommendations: sizes, materials, finishes, gas (natural gas or propane), water and electrical setup, and installation

Manage customer
s in our shared inbox: questions, quotes, order updates and problems

Talk to our suppliers and manufacturers: place orders, ask for lead times and tracking, and solve shipping problems

Handle order fulfillment: check new orders, send them to suppliers, share tracking, and help with damages, returns and refunds

Keep notes on every lead and order so nothing falls through the cracks

.

What we are looking for

At least 2 years of customer service or sales experience, including phone calls (US customers preferred)

Excellent spoken and written English. You are confident and friendly on the phone.

Someone who likes selling: you follow up, ask good questions, and help a customer d

Enjoys learning technical details and can explain them to a customer in simple words

Organized and detail-oriented. You finish what you start.

Shopify experience is a plus. We will train you on our products and tools (Shopify, Gmail, our phone system and Asana).

Why join us

A positive, supportive team: friendly people who help each other and share what they learn

Real experience in high-ticket sales: learn consultative selling of products worth $1,000 to $15,000, a skill that stays valuable for your whole career

Keep learning: product training, and new skills as we add new brands and tools

Work with modern AI tools: we use AI every day to work smarter, and you will learn to use it well

Ownership that matters: your work directly shapes the customer experience and our sales results

Fully remote and long-term: work from home in a stable role that grows as the company grows

title: High Paying Static Ads Designer for 8-figure DTC Brand
description:
We are looking for a highly creative Static Ad Editor who understands direct response advertising and can create high-performing static ads for Meta.



This role is not just about making ads look good. You need to understand why an ad works, how to match the creative to the customer’s awareness level, and how to write clear, direct, emotionally relevant copy that makes someone stop scrolling.



You will be responsible for creating static image ads from concept to final design, including the headline, supporting copy, layout, image direction, and overall creative execution.



Responsibilities

- Create static ads for Meta that are designed to drive clicks, conversions, and profitable customer acquisition

- Develop new ad concepts based on customer pain points, emotions, product benefits, and proven direct response angles

- Write your own ad copy, including hooks, headlines, subheadlines, callouts, and supporting text

- Understand and apply the 3 key customer awareness levels when creating ads:



Trigger Awareness: The customer is feeling a problem but may not fully understand what is causing it yet

Exploration Awareness: The customer is actively looking for answers, explanations, or possible solutions

Evaluation Awareness: The customer understands the problem and is comparing products, mechanisms, benefits, or offers



- Create ads that match the customer’s current mindset instead of using generic headlines

- Turn creative briefs, customer research, and product angles into strong static ad concepts

- Work with the creative team to test new hooks, visual formats, angles, and messaging styles

- Analyze winning ads and understand the creative strategy behind them

- Create variations of winning concepts without simply copying the same ad repeatedly

- Ensure the final static ads are clean, easy to read, visually strong, and aligned with the brand

- Balance strong direct response messaging with tasteful, compliant, and brand-appropriate execution



Requirements

- Have previously worked for 8-9 figure DTC Brands

- Experience creating static ads for supplements, wellness, beauty, or similar direct response brands

- Strong understanding of Meta ads and what makes someone stop scrolling

- Ability to write clear, compelling ad copy without relying on a copywriter for every concept

- Strong understanding of customer awareness levels and how messaging changes at each stage

- Ability to create ads that speak directly to customer problems, desires, objections, and emotions

- Strong design sense, including layout, hierarchy, typography, spacing, and visual clarity

- Ability to create multiple ad concepts quickly while maintaining quality

- Comfortable receiving feedback and improving concepts based on performance data

- Strong attention to detail

- Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar design tools

- Understanding of direct response principles is a major plus



What We Are Looking For

- We want someone who can think like a creative strategist, write like a direct response marketer, and design like a performance-focused editor.

- The right person should be able to look at a product angle and create multiple static ad concepts that are visually engaging, emotionally specific, and written for the right awareness level.

- You should not need every headline handed to you. You should be able to study the customer, understand what they are feeling, and turn that into strong static ads that can be tested on Meta.



Bonus Points

- Experience with women’s wellness, supplements, beauty, postpartum, or health-related products

- Experience creating ads for high-spend Meta ad accounts

- Ability to break down why an ad works or does not work

- Ability to use AI tools to speed up concepting, copywriting, and design iteration

- Understanding of direct response frameworks, hooks, mechanisms, objections, and offer positioning





DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE:

- A beginner

- An agency or working with an agency.

- DO NOT HAVE background in Ecommerce DTC

- People who need direction or move slowly



How to Apply

Step 1: Fill-out the application form 



Step 2: Initial Screening

Step 3: Paid Test

Step 4: Final Interview with the CEO.

s.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• US$4-8 per hour, based on demonstrated ability and verified experience; your rate is agreed before training starts

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: 

We only review applications submitted through this link. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph, or message us here and we'll send it.

title: E - Commerce Social Media & Content Design Manager
description:
About the Role

We're hiring a part-time Content Designer to own the visual output of our brand — the statics, video, and marketing collateral that define how we look and feel across social, ads, and every channel our brand shows up on.

Reporting directly to the founder, you'll be the maker behind our creative: designing, editing, and shaping the assets that carry our identity into the world. This role is execution-focused at its core — but over time we want someone who brings fresh creative direction, not just clean output.



Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week), with a clear path to full-time as the business grows

Time Zone: At least half of your working hours must overlap with EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design

Design static graphics for organic social feeds, paid ads, campaign moments, and brand launches

Design marketing collateral for both print and digital — posters, flyers, packaging inserts, event materials

Adapt and resize creative across every format and channel

Build and maintain a reusable template system to move faster without losing craft

Own the visual consistency of the brand across every asset — typography, colour, spacing, and detail



Video Editing

Edit and assemble short-form video (Reels, TikToks, video ads) from raw footage — UGC, product shoots — editing, not filming

Add motion, text, transitions, and sound design that feel native to each platform

Cut multiple versions and aspect ratios of the same asset for different placements

Photography Post-Production

Retouch and colour-correct product and lifestyle photography for ads, social, and marketing use

Composite and adapt product shots into layouts, ad creative, and campaign visuals



Tools & Platforms

Design: Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva

Video Editing: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects

3D: Blender or Spline

Photography: Adobe Lightroom



Required Skills & Experience

Design Experience: 4–6+ years designing and editing content for consumer brands, ideally CPG

⚠️ Portfolio Required: A strong portfolio showing real range across static design, short-form video, and print collateral — please include a portfolio link in your application

Social-First Visual Fluency: Understands what stops a thumb on TikTok vs. what earns a save on Instagram — fluent in the visual language of social

Typography & Detail: Strong typographic sensibility with an eye for detail that holds at every size and crop

Video Editing: Comfortable editing from raw footage — pacing, sound, and motion, not just cuts

3D: Working proficiency in Blender or Spline — able to build clean product renders and simple animated scenes for social and ads

Photo Retouching: Solid retouching and colour correction skills

Working Style: Proactive self-starter who executes independently and organises their own pipeline

Nice to Have

Motion design, illustration, or brand identity work in your background



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: Senior Fitness Studio Client Operations & Billing Coordinator
description:
We are an established U.S.-based boutique fitness studio serving recurring clients through scheduled appointments, memberships and individual services.



We are looking for an exceptionally organized, experienced and dependable female remote professional to take ownership of the administrative side of our client operations.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry position.



We are looking for someone with significant administrative experience who can learn our business thoroughly and become the person we trust to keep our scheduling, billing, client accounts and administrative workflow accurate and organized.



For the right person, this is intended to be a long-term position.



Your Responsibilities



You will take primary responsibility for:



-Client scheduling, rescheduling and cancellations



-Maintaining accurate appointment schedules



-Managing client memberships and remaining session credits



-Reviewing billing, payments, renewals and account adjustments



-Reconciling client accounts and identifying discrepancies



-Following up on outstanding payments and administrative items



-Responding professionally to client scheduling and account-related messages



-Tracking membership renewals and expirations



-Maintaining accurate notes in our scheduling/CRM system



-Reviewing upcoming schedules proactively for conflicts or mistakes



-Coordinating scheduling and client requests with our on-site staff



-Following established policies for cancellations, credits, holds and account changes



-Creating simple administrative reports and tracking sheets when needed



-Keeping confidential client and business information secure



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone exceptionally accurate, responsible and proactive.



You should be the type of person who:



-Notices when numbers don't match



-Double-checks important work



-Keeps excellent records



-Follows a task through until it is completely resolved



-Notices potential problems before being asked



-Can manage many small details without losing track of them



-Learns systems and procedures quickly



-Is comfortable making decisions within established policies



-Communicates clearly and professionally with clients and team members



-Can work independently without constant supervision

Required Experience



-5+ years of professional administrative, operations, billing, scheduling or client-account experience preferred



-Strong experience working remotely



-Excellent written and spoken English



-Strong computer and technology skills



-Experience with scheduling, CRM, membership or practice-management software



-comfortable working with numbers, billing and account reconciliation



-Excellent attention to detail



-Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses strongly preferred



-Stable work history and professional references



-Experience in an appointment-based, membership-based, medical, wellness, fitness, spa or other client-service business is a plus.



Hours



-This is a part-time position.



-You must be consistently available for approximately a 2-hour working block between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Thursday for time-sensitive scheduling, client communication and administrative needs.



-Additional administrative work may be completed more flexibly.



-We expect approximately 8–15 hours per week, depending on business needs. Hours may increase during busy periods and decrease during quieter periods.



-Please apply only if this schedule works for you consistently.



Compensation



$15–$20 USD/hour depending on experience and ability.



We are willing to pay at the top of the range for an exceptional candidate who has the experience and ability to independently take ownership of this role.



Long-Term Opportunity



We're not looking for someone to complete occasional tasks. We're looking for a dependable professional who can learn our business deeply, become an important part of our operations and stay with us long term.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1) A brief introduction and why this position interests you.



2) Your experience managing scheduling, billing and/or client accounts.



3) The software/CRM/scheduling systems you have used.



4) Your experience working for U.S.-based companies.



5) How long you worked with your two most recent long-term employers.



6) Confirmation that you can consistently work a 2-hour block between 10 AM–2 PM Eastern Time, Monday–Thursday.



7) Your desired hourly rate.



8) Please begin your application with the words “DETAILS MATTER.”



Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.

title: Amazon Wholesale VA / Brand Sourcer / Supplier Outreach Specialist
description:
About the Role:



I’m looking for a reliable and motivated Amazon Wholesale Virtual Assistant to join my team and help grow my Amazon business.



The ideal candidate has experience with the Amazon Wholesale business model, particularly in brand sourcing, supplier research, distributor sourcing, and supplier outreach.



You should be comfortable identifying profitable wholesale opportunities, researching brands and distributors, analyzing Amazon listings, and reaching out to potential suppliers to open wholesale accounts.



I’m looking for someone who can become a long-term member of the team, continuously improve their sourcing skills, and consistently help us build strong supplier relationships and profitable wholesale opportunities.



What you’ll do:

As an Amazon Wholesale VA, your main responsibilities will include:



- Researching profitable brands and products to sell on Amazon

- Finding authorized distributors, wholesalers, and direct brand opportunities

- Conducting brand and supplier research

- Reaching out to brands, distributors, and suppliers via email, phone, or contact forms

- Following up with suppliers and tracking responses

- Requesting wholesale applications, catalogs, price lists, and account information

- Analyzing supplier price lists for profitable Amazon opportunities

- Reviewing Amazon listings, Buy Box history, sales rank, competition, and pricing trends

- Analyzing Keepa graphs and historical product data

- Using SellerAmp SAS and other wholesale research tools to evaluate ROI, profit, fees, competition, and sales potential

- Checking whether brands and products meet our sourcing criteria

- Organizing brands, suppliers, contacts, price lists, and product leads in Google Sheets

- Maintaining accurate records of supplier outreach and account status

- Communicating regularly about progress, opportunities, and challenges



What I’m Looking For

- Experience with the Amazon Wholesale business model

- Experience with brand sourcing and supplier research

- Experience contacting brands, distributors, and wholesalers

- Strong understanding of Keepa

- Experience using SellerAmp SAS

- Ability to analyze Amazon listings and product profitability

- Experience reviewing wholesale price lists

- Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central

- Strong Google search and online research skills

- Proficiency with Google Sheets and Google Workspace

- Good written and verbal communication skills

- Professional supplier outreach and follow-up skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to follow sourcing criteria and SOPs

- Ability to work independently

- Reliable and professional work ethic

- Willingness to learn and continuously improve



Experience with tools such as SmartScout, ScanUnlimited, RevSeller, or similar Amazon Wholesale tools is a plus.



There will also be opportunities to learn additional Amazon Wholesale skills as you grow within the role.



To apply for the job:

1. Change the subject line to 'I want to be your Amazon Wholesale VA'

2. In the first 2-3 sentences of your message, tell us what excites you most about this role and what makes you a great fit.

3. Then, answer these questions with the numbers:



A) Describe your experience with Amazon Wholesale, preferably with brand sourcing, distributor research, and supplier outreach. Be specific about the tasks you handled.



B) If a supplier sends you a price list with hundreds or thousands of products, explain how you would analyze it and identify profitable opportunities.



C) What makes you stand out from other applicants? What unique value would you bring to the team?



Note: Only applicants who follow ALL instructions will be considered.



I look forward to reading what you provide.



Thank you!

title: Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder)
description:
Dear Applicants,



Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder) – We're Hiring!



Our product team plans every page: the idea, which sections go where, and the copy. You bring it to life on our Shopify store as a clean, polished page that works beautifully on every screen. If you have years of Shopify experience, a sharp eye for detail, and enjoy using AI tools to work faster, this role is for you.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

 • Build and update pages on our Shopify store (product, collection, landing and campaign pages) from briefs prepared by our product team

 • Customise our existing theme (sections, blocks and templates) and work with page builder apps such as GemPages, PageFly or Shogun

 • Make every page look polished and on-brand: consistent spacing, alignment, font sizes, colours and image quality

 • Create or adapt simple visuals (banners, section images) using AI tools and our in-house design guidelines, and judge whether the result looks right before using it

 • Use AI coding tools (such as Codex or Claude) to speed up builds, and check and test everything they produce before it goes live

 • Test every page before publishing: mobile layout, loading speed, links, and that it matches the brief

 • Flag layout or usability problems early and suggest simple fixes, for example content that will not work well on a phone

 • Update pages for launches, promotions and seasonal campaigns



You should have:

 • At least 4 years of hands-on Shopify experience building and improving store pages

 • Confidence editing Liquid and CSS within an existing theme (adjusting sections, adding settings, fixing layouts). You will customise our theme, not build themes or apps from scratch

 • Experience with at least one page builder app (GemPages, PageFly, Shogun or similar)

 • Evidence of improving a page's conversion or performance, with the before and after to show for it

 • A strong eye for visual detail: you notice when spacing is off, text is too small, images look stretched or a page feels cluttered

 • Good UI/UX awareness: you know what makes a page easy to use on a phone, and how to fix it when it is not

 • Comfort using AI tools to create visuals and write or edit code, and checking their output carefully



You do not need to be a graphic designer. Visuals can be created with AI tools using our design guidelines. What matters most is your eye for detail and your sense of what makes a page look good and sell well.



Note:

 • Full-time basis, 40 hrs/week

 • Monday to Friday

 • 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included

 • Your CV/Resume

 • A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

title: Accountant - U.S. GAAP Experience
description:
Remote Accountant | U.S. GAAP Experience Required



Location: Remote | International Applicants Welcome

Engagement: Independent Contractor | Long-Term Opportunity

Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time Business Hours



About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Remote Accountant to support the accounting and financial operations of multiple U.S.-based companies across several industries.



This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on accounting professional who is comfortable managing multiple responsibilities, working independently and supporting a growing organization with diverse accounting needs.



Direct experience performing accounting work under U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP) for U.S.-based companies is a mandatory requirement.



We are looking for someone with practical accounting experience who can contribute beyond routine bookkeeping and take ownership of accounting responsibilities with accuracy, sound judgment and consistent follow-through.



Key Responsibilities



Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjusting entries.



Perform bank, credit card, general ledger and balance-sheet reconciliations.



Support monthly, quarterly and year-end closing activities.



Prepare financial statements, supporting schedules and management reports.



Maintain accurate general ledger records across multiple business entities.



Investigate discrepancies, research accounting issues and resolve errors.



Support accounts payable, accounts receivable and intercompany accounting.



Assist with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and cash-flow reporting.



Coordinate audit documentation and support financial compliance requirements.



Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting and efficiency.



Collaborate with U.S.-based Finance leadership and operational teams.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must meet all of the following qualifications:



Minimum 3 years of direct, hands-on accounting experience applying U.S. GAAP for U.S.-based companies.



At least 3-5 years of professional accounting experience with meaningful responsibility for general ledger accounting and financial reporting.



Demonstrated experience with journal entries, accruals, reconciliations and monthly or quarterly closing processes.



Experience preparing or substantially contributing to financial statements.



Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies and resolve problems.



Proficiency with accounting software or ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Xero or comparable platforms.



Strong Microsoft Excel skills and attention to detail.



Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work independently with minimal supervision.



Important: General bookkeeping, AP/AR processing, external audit experience or employment with an international organization does not independently satisfy the required hands-on U.S. GAAP accounting experience.



Preferred Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.



CPA certification or equivalent professional accounting credential (not required).



Experience supporting multiple U.S. business entities or companies across different industries.



Experience with intercompany accounting, consolidations and multi-entity financial reporting.



Experience with financial dashboards, Power BI, financial analysis or FP&A support.



Familiarity with AI tools, accounting automation and process improvements.



Experience working directly with U.S.-based accounting or finance leadership.



Work Schedule & Contractor Expectations



Remote independent contractor engagement.



Work hours generally fall within 8:00 AM-8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday-Friday.



Expected workload of approximately 50-60 hours per week, depending on business needs.



Must have a reliable personal computer and high-speed internet connection.



Must maintain current antivirus protection, an active firewall and updated computer security.



Backup internet and power arrangements are required.



Must have a private, secure workspace suitable for handling confidential financial information.



Must be comfortable working independently and communicating regularly with U.S.-based teams.



Compensation & Engagement



Compensation will be based on relevant experience, demonstrated accounting capabilities and the contractor's proposed monthly rate.



Applicants must provide an all-inclusive monthly contractor bid in USD, based on an anticipated workload of 50-60 hours per week.



This is an independent contractor opportunity without employee benefits. Payments are made monthly on net-30 terms through an approved payment method.



We are interested in developing an ongoing contractor relationship, with an initial engagement of up to one year and potential renewal based on business needs, performance and overall fit.



How to Apply



Please
 
 with the subject:



Remote Accountant Application



Include your current resume and the following information:



A brief overview of your relevant accounting experience.



The U.S.-based companies or clients you have supported and the approximate dates of those engagements.



Your proposed monthly contractor bid in USD, based on the expected workload of 50-60 hours per week.



Your availability to work within U.S. Eastern Time business hours and your earliest possible start date.



Important Application Requirements



Your resume must clearly demonstrate:



At least 3 years of direct, hands-on accounting experience applying U.S. GAAP for U.S.-based companies.



Relevant experience with general ledger accounting, financial reporting and monthly or quarterly close.



Substantive accounting responsibilities beyond basic bookkeeping, AP/AR processing or external audit.



The accounting systems and software you have used professionally.



A clear employment history, including employers, positions and dates of employment.



Applications that do not clearly establish the required U.S. GAAP experience will not advance in the selection process.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to discuss their professional experience, technical capabilities and remote work arrangements during the interview process.



Please do not contact our company, affiliated businesses, leadership or employees directly through
, phone, LinkedIn, social media or other channels regarding this opportunity.



Direct outreach outside the designated recruitment process will not be considered and may result in disqualification.



We appreciate your cooperation in respecting our recruitment process.

Our Patient Representatives are the first point of contact for patients, handling inbound calls, answering inquiries, providing information about our services, scheduling appointments, and ensuring a professional and positive patient experience.



This is a hands-on leadership role. In addition to managing and training the team, the Team Lead / Trainer will also take inbound calls when team members are on break, unavailable, or when call volume is high and there is a queue of waiting patients.

Please submit your resume and cover letter explaining your relevant call center, QA, training, and team leadership experience.

title: Power BI Data & Inventory Analytics Specialist
description:
We are an established, fast-growing multi-channel e-commerce brand managing a catalog of approximately 450 active products. We partner with large-scale distributors and manage data pipelines across several retail platforms and independent web storefronts. Our business model relies on operational efficiency, data precision, and real-time capital allocation.



Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled Data Analytics & Inventory Specialist to build, optimize, and maintain an automated data pipeline using Power BI and the Microsoft Ecosystem.

Your primary mission is to consolidate data from multiple distinct sources—including daily/weekly distributor spreadsheets, multi-channel platform sales data, and advertising metrics—into a unified, clean, and highly automated decision system that guides our replenishment and tracking.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Multi-Channel Profitability Dashboards

 * Build a unified data model in Power BI aggregating data from various third-party platform exports, independent storefront datasets, and ad platform reports.

 * Standardize and map product variations across disparate channels into a single master product table to handle naming and SKU discrepancies.

 * Write DAX measures to calculate true net margins per item by accurately separating channel-specific overhead and marketing expenses.

 2. Automated Supplier Inventory Matching

 * Utilize tools like Power Automate to streamline data extraction from recurring email data dumps, auto-saving files to OneDrive or SharePoint.

 * Build automated "Buy Alert" modules that cross-reference incoming vendor stock levels against current internal inventory deficiencies to flag purchasing opportunities.

 3. Predictive Replenishment Forecasting

 * Structure robust data-cleaning steps in Power Query to normalize varying spreadsheet layouts and messy source files without breaking the primary dashboards.

 * Develop short-term and long-term moving velocity metrics to project exact depletion timelines and automate reorder point triggers.

 4. Capital Allocation & Budget Tools

 * Design interactive parameters (such as What-If sliders) to filter procurement metrics against fixed capital limits.

 * Program ranking models that dynamically prioritize item lists based on velocity, margin performance, and advertising efficiency.

 



 Required Technical Qualifications



* Strong proficiency in Power BI Desktop & Power BI Service (DAX data modeling and dashboard layout design).

* Proficiency with Power Query for advanced data cleansing, row filtering, cell normalization, and structural formatting.

* Familiarity or experience with workflow automation tools (such as Power Automate) for automated file management and ingestion.

* Extreme Attention to Detail: Our inventory health depends entirely on exact metrics. Missing data, uncleaned cells, or structural oversight in reporting cannot occur. Precision is always prioritized over speed.

* Experience or background in the e-commerce industry or multi-channel retail logistics is a major plus (knowledge of the Amazon ecosystem is highly valued but not strictly necessary).





 Missing a qualification? Apply Anyway!

If you match most of the requirements but are missing a specific tool or niche skill on this list, please do not let that stop you from applying! We value transparency, problem-solving skills, and a strong work ethic just as much as past experience.

If you are missing a specific tool (for example, you are a Power BI expert but have never used Power Automate for email workflows):



* Be upfront with us in your application. Tell us exactly which qualification you are missing.

* Let us know your learning plan. If you are willing and able to research, upskill, and fill in that specific knowledge gap over your first few weeks on the job, we are more than happy to give you the time and flexibility to do so.

Small-Business Sales & Business Development – Australian social media and AI services (independent contractor)



We are a small Australian business that builds practical, AI-powered services for other businesses. We have services that work, and we need someone who loves selling to help more businesses find them.



This is a long-term independent contractor engagement, remote from the Philippines.



WHAT YOU WOULD SELL



1. An online social media posting service (main focus): a done-for-you service for Australian small businesses. We capture the owner's own voice and post regularly for them, so their business stays visible without them having to find the time.

2. AI and automation services (second focus): we help established Australian businesses (usually 10 or more office staff) remove repetitive admin work using AI and automation. Here your job is to find and qualify good prospects and book a conversation with our founder, who handles the detailed discussion and closes the deal.



WHAT THE WORK INVOLVES



- finding Australian small businesses that would genuinely benefit, and the right person to talk to;

- contacting them by message,
, LinkedIn and phone, and following up intelligently;

- explaining the posting service simply and honestly, handling questions and objections, and signing up clients;

- qualifying AI-services prospects and booking calls with the founder;

- keeping accurate records of every prospect and conversation; and

- telling us what you hear from the market, so we can improve the offer and the targeting.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- you genuinely enjoy selling and have done it successfully: you can show deals you closed yourself, not just calls made;

- excellent spoken and written English, comfortable talking with Australian business owners;

- experience selling to small-business owners (Australian or US) is highly desirable;

- good judgement: you can tell a real prospect from a waste of time, and say why; and

- organised and persistent with follow-up.



We are not looking for someone who runs their own agency or juggles several clients. We want someone who wants to build something with us over the long term.



FEES



US$4.50 per hour (about PHP 48,000 a month at around 40 hours a week), plus success fees for clients you bring in who sign up and pay. There are no targets in the first month while we learn together what works. You are an independent contractor: you choose when and how you work, and you invoice weekly for the work done.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words SELL WHAT WE BUILD, then answer each question below. Applications that don't answer the questions will not be considered.



1. Describe your sales experience: what you sold, to whom, your exact part (finding prospects, booking meetings, closing), and your results with numbers.

5. Tell us about a time your sales approach wasn't working and you changed it. What did you change, and what happened?

6. Your DISC profile as four numbers that add up to 100, in the order D / I / S / C (for example 30 / 25 / 20 / 25).

7. Your CV, your availability, and confirmation that you're comfortable working as an independent contractor from the Philippines.

- Maintain a simple scorecard for mature first-week launches, a fixed catalog set, available engagement, tracked links and podcast-related enquiries. Run one manageable growth experiment at a time, with a short weekly update and recommendation.



Decisions and boundaries



Work from an episode brief, templates and agreed publishing standards. E.J. retains editorial direction, recording, business priorities and growth guidance. He reviews initial packages; the intended ongoing workflow is approval by exception. Escalate sensitive content, significant editorial changes, new spending and changes to offer messaging. Ops Dot supports drafts, analysis and planning when engaged; you verify accuracy and own completion.



This role excludes substantive audio/video editing, all-platform social management, website development, paid advertising, sales calls and booking two additional guests monthly. Existing production and social owners retain their work. Flag missing inputs or workload problems early; do not silently expand the role.



What matters and how to apply



Strong written English, dependable follow-through, careful listening and link checks, basic publishing/marketing coordination, spreadsheets and thoughtful AI use. Podcast or RedCircle experience helps; evidence of independent execution and learning matters more than tool familiarity. The operational test is whether E.J. can hand off a recording and have an accurate, properly promoted episode go live without chasing anyone. Growth and business attribution remain core objectives; no result is guaranteed.



Answer the five questions below briefly and include one existing relevant sample or a short description. Keep unpaid application work to about 15 minutes; no custom campaign is required.



Five screening questions



Pay depends on relevant experience and demonstrated ability. Existing or redacted examples are sufficient.



1. Describe a podcast or similar publishing workflow you personally carried from handoff to release. What did you own, how did you verify the finished result, and what did you handle without prompting? Include one existing writing or publishing sample, or a short description if it is confidential.



2. You receive finished audio and an AI transcript. How would you check audio completeness, speaker or guest names, transcript accuracy, title, show notes, links and CTA before scheduling? What would you fix yourself and what would you return to the editor or E.J.?



3. The editor is late and John needs newsletter copy before the release. How would you protect the deadline, keep people informed and d
 when E.J. needs to be involved? Explain how you would keep agreed growth work from disappearing behind publishing tasks.



4. A release is two days old, last week’s has seven days of downloads, and tracked clicks increased without clear enquiry attribution. What would you report, avoid concluding and test next in one manageable growth experiment?



5. What weekly hours can you reliably reserve, including a full listen to each episode and release-day checks? Give your Philippines-time availability, earliest start, relevant publishing-tool experience and how you use and verify AI-assisted work. We will agree final hours after reviewing the workflow.

title: Elite Operations VA, ShipHero WMS & 3PL Support ($5/hour, full-time)
description:
About us:

Pine Path Logistics is a US-based 3PL fulfillment company. We store, pick, pack and ship products for ecommerce brands and TikTok Shop sellers, and we run our warehouse on ShipHero.



Who we're looking for

This role is for someone who:



- Takes ownership and finishes tasks without being chased

- Catches mistakes before they cause problems

- Is a quick learner who figures things out on their own (help docs, testing, research) before asking

- Communicates clearly and proactively, including when something is wrong



You don't need to know everything on day one. We provide training and ongoing support. We're looking for someone smart and eager to learn, with some baseline knowledge of warehouse management systems and 3PL operations.



What you'll do



ShipHero WMS



- Store setup: Connect and configure client stores (Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon and others), and fix sync or integration problems.

- Shipping methods: Set up and maintain carrier accounts, shipping methods and shipping-method mapping for each client.

- Product management: Create and update SKUs, kits/bundles, barcodes, weights and dimensions.

- Automation rules: Build and troubleshoot rules for order routing, carrier/service selection, tags, holds and packing instructions.

- Inventory: Monitor inventory levels, process adjustments and reconcile mismatches.

- Purchase orders and receiving: Create POs for incoming client inventory so the warehouse can receive against them, including lot and batch codes where required. Flag any inbound shipment that's missing a PO.

- Billing: Set up and maintain billing rules for each client, and prepare monthly billing reports.

- Reporting: Pull ShipHero reports as needed, such as inventory, orders and shipping.



Sales and admin



- CRM: We don't use a CRM yet but plan to add one. Once it's in place, you'll handle data entry: adding and updating contacts, companies and deals, logging notes, and keeping records clean.

- Proposals and contracts: Help draft client proposals, pricing quotes and service agreements.

- DocuSign: Prepare and send contracts for signature.

- General support: Help set up new clients in our systems and document processes as you go.



Requirements



- Proven experience as a VA, ideally in ecommerce, logistics or operations

- Experience with ecommerce platforms such as Shopify or TikTok Shop

- Exceptional attention to detail. Small data errors cause shipping and billing mistakes.

- Excellent written English for proposals, contracts and internal communication

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for bulk updates

- Fast, reliable internet

- Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific business hours (exact schedule can be discussed)



Preferred:



- Baseline knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS) such as ShipHero, ShipStation or Extensiv, and of 3PL operations

- Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot

- Experience with DocuSign or writing proposals

- Experience with lot/batch tracking (food, beverage or supplements)



Details:



Hours: Full-time

Pay: $5 per hour

Start date: ASAP

Training: Provided, with ongoing support



How to apply



Please follow these instructions carefully. Following directions is part of the evaluation, and applications that skip any step won't be reviewed.



1. Include the word "Apple" in your application's subject line or title.

2. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net.

3. Record a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and walking us through your relevant experience, including any work with warehouse management systems, ecommerce platforms or operations and admin.

4. Include your available working hours in Pacific Time.

Explain our services and pricing clearly

title: Aprinta — Promotional Products & Apparel Purchasing Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Department: Purchasing & Order Operations

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Aprinta Operations



About Aprinta



Aprinta is a growing branded products platform helping businesses purchase and manage promotional products, custom apparel, commercial printing, company stores, packaging, kitting and fulfillment.



We are building an operations organization capable of supporting a large volume of branded merchandise orders across the United States.



We are looking for a Promotional Products & Apparel Purchasing Specialist to help manage purchasing, sourcing, production and vendor relationships.



The Position



This is not a basic order-entry or virtual assistant position.



You will be responsible for helping manage promotional merchandise and apparel orders from customer approval through production and delivery.



You will work directly with suppliers, manufacturers, decorators and production partners.



You will be responsible for sourcing products, checking inventory, obtaining vendor pricing, creating purchase orders, coordinating artwork and proofs, tracking production and resolving problems.



Candidates with previous promotional products industry experience are strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

Order Management

Review incoming orders for accuracy and completeness.

Verify product SKU, color, quantity, size breakdown, decoration requirements and delivery date.

Confirm product inventory before placing orders.

Identify missing information before an order enters production.

Manage orders from approval through final delivery.

Maintain accurate status information for every assigned order.

Product Sourcing



When a specific product isn't available or isn't competitive, you will be expected to find a solution.



Responsibilities include:



Search supplier catalogs and websites.

Identify comparable products.

Check inventory.

Compare pricing.

Compare decoration capabilities.

Compare production times.

Find alternatives for out-of-stock products.

Identify better-value alternatives when appropriate.

Locate new suppliers and manufacturers.



You should become an expert at answering:



Where can Aprinta buy this product at the best combination of price, quality and delivery time?



Purchasing

Obtain supplier pricing.

Verify net/distributor pricing.

Understand setup charges and decoration charges.

Compare supplier costs.

Negotiate pricing on larger opportunities.

Create purchase orders.

Submit POs to suppliers.

Verify supplier acknowledgements.

Compare acknowledgements against the original PO.

Resolve discrepancies before production.

Promotional Products



You may manage products including:



Drinkware

Bags

Technology accessories

Pens and writing instruments

Awards

Office products

Trade-show products

Outdoor products

Food and gifts

Employee recognition products

Corporate gifts

Custom-manufactured merchandise

Apparel



You may also manage:



T-shirts

Polos

Dress shirts

Sweatshirts

Outerwear

Headwear

Uniforms

Workwear

Bags and accessories



Responsibilities include confirming style numbers, colors, size availability and inventory before purchasing.



Decoration



Candidates should understand or be prepared to learn decoration methods including:



Screen printing

Embroidery

Heat transfer

Direct-to-garment

Direct-to-film

Pad printing

Laser engraving

Debossing

Full-color digital printing

Sublimation



You will need to understand how decoration method, number of colors, imprint locations and quantities affect production cost.



Artwork & Proof Management

Submit customer artwork to suppliers.

Confirm correct artwork is attached to each order.

Obtain virtual or production proofs.

Compare proofs against customer specifications.

Verify logo placement.

Verify imprint size.

Verify imprint colors.

Verify product color.

Confirm decoration locations.

Coordinate corrections.

Ensure required approvals are obtained before production.

Supplier Management



Develop strong working relationships with suppliers and decorators.



Responsibilities include:



Maintaining supplier contacts.

Tracking supplier performance.

Identifying preferred suppliers.

Maintaining backup suppliers.

Monitoring pricing.

Resolving supplier problems.

Obtaining credits and reprints when vendors make mistakes.

Continually identifying better suppliers.



Experience with major U.S. promotional-products and apparel suppliers is a major advantage.



Examples may include suppliers such as SanMar, S&S Activewear, alphabroder, PCNA, Hit Promotional Products, Gemline, Koozie Group, Logomark and similar industry suppliers.



Production & Shipping

Track production schedules.

Confirm ship dates.

Follow up proactively with suppliers.

Identify late orders before deadlines are missed.

Obtain tracking information.

Verify shipping destinations.

Monitor important deliveries.

Escalate potential delivery problems immediately.

Problem Resolution



When an order has a problem, you are expected to help solve it.



Examples include:



Product goes out of stock.

Supplier misses production date.

Incorrect product arrives.

Decoration is incorrect.

Quantity is short.

Product arrives damaged.

Customer changes specifications.

Shipment is delayed.

Vendor charges don't match the quote.



Work with the supplier and Aprinta team to determine the fastest and most cost-effective solution.



Cost & Margin Management



You are purchasing on behalf of Aprinta, so protecting margin is an important part of the position.



Responsibilities include:



Confirming supplier pricing.

Comparing costs between vendors.

Recording actual product and decoration costs.

Identifying unexpected charges.

Finding purchasing savings.

Negotiating larger orders.

Identifying products where Aprinta's existing costs are not competitive.

Ideal Experience



We are especially interested in candidates who have worked for:



Promotional products distributors

Promotional product suppliers

Branded merchandise companies

Apparel distributors

Embroidery companies

Screen-printing companies

Corporate merchandise programs

Purchasing or sourcing organizations



Previous experience with the U.S. promotional-products industry is highly desirable.



What We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized

Highly detail-oriented

Comfortable managing many simultaneous orders

Strong at online product research

Comfortable with spreadsheets

Comfortable communicating with U.S. suppliers

Able to negotiate professionally

Proactive

Resourceful

Accountable

Able to work independently



Most importantly, we want someone who takes ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



Success in This Role



Performance will be measured by:



Order accuracy

On-time shipment percentage

Gross-margin protection

Purchasing savings

Supplier performance

Order turnaround time

Error rate

Problem resolution

Open-order aging

Accuracy of purchasing records

Number of orders requiring management intervention



Our expectation is:



If an order is assigned to you, you own the purchasing and production process until that order is successfully delivered.



How to Apply



Please provide:



A summary of your relevant experience.

Your experience in the promotional-products or apparel industries.

Promotional-product suppliers you have worked with.

Apparel suppliers you have worked with.

Your experience with product sourcing.

Your experience checking supplier inventory.

Your experience issuing purchase orders.

Your experience managing artwork and proofs.

The order-management, ERP or industry software you have used.

Your current availability.

Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.



Please begin your application with the words “MERCH OPERATIONS” so we know you carefully reviewed the position.

title: lead researcher
description:
ay: $2/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: Experienced Medical Coder — IV Infusion, Primary Care & Pediatrics
description:
Experienced Medical Coder — IV Infusion, Primary Care & Pediatrics

About Our Practice



We are a growing U.S. medical practice looking for an experienced medical coder and insurance authorization specialist to support our outpatient practices.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience with U.S. medical coding, claims review, insurance verification, prior authorizations, tracking, claim tracking, and denial prevention.



A major part of this position will involve office-based IV infusion coding and prior authorizations, as well as reviewing and correcting claims for our primary care and pediatric practices.



This is a hands-on coding position for someone who understands how medical services are actually documented, coded, billed, and reimbursed by U.S. insurance companies.



Position



Medical Coder / IV Infusion Authorization & Claims Specialist



Work arrangement: Remote Schedule: Part-time to start, with potential for additional hours Experience: Experienced U.S. medical coder required



Primary Responsibilities



IV Infusion & Specialty Therapy



You will be responsible for helping our practice properly authorize, code, and bill office-based infusion services.



Responsibilities include:



Verify insurance eligibility and benefits.

Determine whether infusion medications are covered under the medical or pharmacy benefit.

Determine whether prior authorization is required.

Obtain and manage prior authorizations.

Communicate with insurance companies and payer authorization departments.

Track authorization numbers, approved units/doses, effective dates, and expiration dates.

Identify appropriate CPT, HCPCS, J-code and ICD-10 codes.

Code IV infusion administration services.

Code hydration and injection services.

Understand time-based infusion coding.

Review medication units and dosage documentation.

Understand buy-and-bill medications.

Review documentation for medical necessity.

Identify payer-specific requirements.

Assist with infusion claim review before submission.

Identify potential denial, bundling, NCCI, modifier, and documentation problems.

Assist with appeals and denied infusion claims.

Primary Care Coding



You will also review and correct claims generated by our primary care practice.



Responsibilities include:



Review office visit claims for accurate CPT and ICD-10 coding.

Review E/M coding and documentation.

Evaluate diagnosis-to-procedure linkage.

Review preventive visits and wellness examinations.

Review problem-oriented visits.

Review immunizations and vaccine administration.

Review laboratory and diagnostic services.

Identify missing or incorrect modifiers.

Correct coding errors before claims are submitted.

Review denied claims and determine the appropriate correction.

Identify undercoding, overcoding, bundling, and documentation issues.

Review claims for payer-specific requirements.

Assist with claim edits and clearinghouse rejections.

Pediatric Coding



Experience with pediatric medical coding is highly preferred.



You may review claims involving:



Well-child visits

New-patient and established-patient visits
