title: Take-off Estimator, Plumbing and Irrigation Pipework (Remote)
description:
About us

Think Water Adelaide is an irrigation, pump and water solutions business in South Australia, part of the Think Water national network. Our projects team designs, supplies and installs irrigation systems for councils, sporting reserves, schools and commercial sites.



We are looking for a quantity surveyor or estimator to prepare pipework materials take-offs for our irrigation projects during busy tender periods. You do not need to be an irrigation specialist. If you have done take-offs for plumbing, hydraulics, fire services or civil pipework, your experience fits this role. You will work directly with our Business Development Manager, who will send you drawings and review your work.



What you will do

You will prepare materials take-offs and bills of quantities from PDF site drawings, cable run tables and specifications, including:

- Measuring mainline and lateral pipe lengths by size and type (HDPE poly and PVC)

- Counting valves, sprinklers, scour valves, valve boxes and fittings

- Working out cable quantities and wire connectors from cable run tables

- Building complete assemblies (valve tap-ins, backflow, master valve and flow sensor, sprinkler connections) from the drawing details and our common standard builds

- Flagging anything on a drawing that looks wrong, unclear or different to our standards, rather than guessing



What we provide

You will work in our Excel take-off workbook. It includes written instructions, our most common standard assemblies, and our product list with item codes, so you select products from a dropdown rather than typing them. Where a job needs something outside our standard range, you add it and flag it, and we source it. You will not need access to our internal systems.



What we need

- Proven experience doing quantity take-offs or BOQs, ideally for plumbing, hydraulics, irrigation or civil pipework

- Strong understanding of pipe, fittings and valve assemblies (electrofusion fittings, poly and PVC, solenoid valves, backflow devices)

- Confident measuring from PDF drawings.

- Strong Excel skills and close attention to detail

- Good written English and willingness to ask questions when something is unclear

- Able to meet agreed deadlines during tender periods

- Some availability during Adelaide business hours (Adelaide is 1.5 to 2.5 hours ahead of Philippine time, depending on daylight saving)



Experience with Australian projects or products is a bonus but not essential, as long as you can follow our instructions closely.



How the work is set up

- Part-time, as-needed work, 

- Rate: US$8 to $15 per hour, depending on experience. 

- Paid fortnightly based on hours logged

- You will sign a confidentiality agreement before receiving any project drawings. All drawings and project information must not be shared, stored outside the agreed location, or reused



To apply

Send a message with the subject line "Pipework Take-off Estimator" and include:

1. A short summary of your take-off experience and the types of projects you have estimated

2. The software you use for measuring drawings

3. An example take-off or BOQ you have prepared, with client details removed

4. Your availability during Adelaide business hours



Applications without the subject line or these details will not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test take-off from a sample drawing.

s and general project correspondence

Accounts & Financial Administration

 and telephone communication skills

title: Solana AI Launch Operator / Frontend Developer — Claude Code, React & Next.js
description:
JOB TITLE

Solana AI Launch Operator / Frontend Developer — Claude Code, React & Next.js



JOB TYPE

Gig / Project-based, with potential for ongoing repeat work.



ABOUT THE ROLE



I’m building a small Solana launch studio and looking for a fast, resourceful builder who can turn approved ideas into complete, polished launch packages.



We provide the idea, narrative research and creative direction. You handle the website, professional branding, X account creation, launch content, testing and handover.



This role requires strong frontend skills, good design judgment and the ability to manage production independently.



You’ll use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or comparable AI tools to accelerate production while taking responsibility for the finished result.



Projects primarily include meme/narrative websites, with occasional lightweight utilities and dashboards using existing APIs.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Build polished, responsive websites using React/Next.js and reusable templates.

• Diagnose and fix AI-generated coding errors independently.

• Develop professional, consistent branding: logos, avatars, X headers, DEX Screener banners and website graphics.

• Propose suitable coin names and tickers for approval when requested.

• Create and configure the project’s X account, including its handle, display name, bio, profile image, header and website link.

• Write clear English website copy, a pinned launch post and short launch-day tweets.

• Prepare approved posts for scheduling or publication during the agreed launch window.

• Connect existing APIs or wallet functionality when included in the brief.

• Build and test any lightweight utility included in the agreed scope.

• Prepare token metadata and launch configuration for approved platforms.

• Deploy websites, configure domains and verify mobile/desktop layouts.

• Deliver organized source code, assets, account access and a concise handover.

• Improve reusable templates and communicate blockers promptly.



DESIGN & BRANDING EXPECTATIONS



Your work should look polished enough for a serious public crypto launch.



You must be able to create a professional logo and a coherent visual identity, then carry that identity across the website, X profile and launch graphics.



We will assess typography, spacing, mobile presentation, image quality, readability and consistency. AI-generated assets are welcome, but you must refine them and check the finished result.



Please apply only if you can personally handle both website production and the required branding/content work.



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Practical React/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript and responsive CSS experience.

• Hands-on experience with AI coding tools.

• Ability to debug, test and deploy independently.

• Strong visual judgment, with examples of website and branding work.

• Clear written English for website copy and social content.

• Familiarity with X account creation and profile setup.

• Familiarity with GitHub, hosting and domain configuration.

• Practical familiarity with Solana tokens, token metadata, mint addresses, wallet connections, Pump.fun, Solscan and DEX Screener.

• Reliable communication during agreed project windows.



Previous crypto websites, complete launch packages or Solana wallet/API integrations are strongly preferred. Familiarity with Proxima or J7 is a bonus.



Be specific about what you have personally shipped and what you are still learning.



WHAT A FINISHED STANDARD PACKAGE INCLUDES



• A deployed website that works on mobile and desktop.

• Working navigation, buttons and all agreed functionality.

• Approved coin name, ticker, token details and links.

• A professional logo/avatar, X header, DEX Screener banner and agreed website graphics.

• Consistent branding across the website and social profile.

• A created and configured X account, with ownership and recovery access handed over.

• Website copy, an X bio, a pinned launch post and four short launch-day tweets.

• Prepared token metadata and launch configuration when included in the brief.

• Organized source code, editable assets where applicable and deployment handover.

• A short summary of completed work, outstanding items and recurring costs.



Features presented as live must work. Prototypes, simulations and planned features must be clearly labelled.



SPEED EXPECTATIONS



Once reusable templates, supported integrations and deployment processes are established, our target is approximately 2–3 hours for a standard template-based launch package.



This is a target to validate during the pilot. Applicants should propose realistic delivery times and identify anything that needs additional scope.



Initial template development, custom designs, new utilities, custom integrations, smart contracts and complex backend systems receive separate timelines and pricing.



Account verification, domain propagation and other external delays should be flagged promptly.



Quality, accuracy and actual completion matter alongside speed.



PAY & PROJECT STRUCTURE



• Target budget: $30–$50 USD per standard launch package using established templates.

• Paid three-hour trial: $40.

• Final package pricing agreed after the trial, based on scope and demonstrated delivery.

• Each project has agreed deliverables, a deadline and revision scope.

• Template development, custom functionality and ongoing maintenance are priced separately.

• Payment for agreed, completed work does not depend on token performance or whether the launch proceeds.

• Potential for ongoing repeat projects as the studio grows.



Approved software subscriptions, hosting, domains and transaction expenses are covered separately.



INTERVIEW & PAID TRIAL



Every shortlisted candidate must complete a 20-minute interview before the paid trial. You’ll be asked to walk through previous work and explain your contribution.



The trial evaluates your ability to produce a complete A–Z package for a potential token launch.



You’ll receive an approved brief, reference examples and an agreed starter template. During the three-hour session, you’ll work on:



• A working preview website and all agreed functionality.

• Coin name/ticker proposals where requested.

• A professional logo and consistent launch graphics.

• X account creation and profile setup using the agreed ownership process.

• Website copy, an X bio, a pinned post and four launch-day tweets.

• Token metadata and launch configuration where included.

• Source code, assets, QA and a brief handover.



The trial is paid regardless of whether you are selected. Final public release and real token deployment require my approval. You will not need to use personal wallet funds.



OWNERSHIP & AVAILABILITY



Source code, assets, domains, X accounts and deployment accounts must be accessible to me and handed over clearly. Account ownership and recovery must remain under my control.



I retain control of wallet credentials and final transaction signing. You prepare and verify launch configuration.



Please state your working hours in Philippine/Bali time (UTC+8), weekly availability, earliest start date and turnaround time during agreed launch windows.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject: Solana Launch Builder — [Your Name]



Please answer each point:



1. Share two live websites you personally built. Explain your exact contribution, tools/templates used and approximate build time.

2. Share one example of a logo or complete branding package you created. Explain which assets you produced yourself.

3. Describe your hands-on Solana experience and link relevant crypto projects. Clearly distinguish shipped work from familiarity.

4. Describe one specific AI-generated coding problem you diagnosed and fixed: what failed, how you found the cause and how you verified the fix.

5. Confirm whether you can independently handle X account creation, professional branding, English copy and launch-content preparation.

6. State your working hours, weekly availability and earliest start date.

7. Give a short, realistic three-hour delivery plan covering the website, branding, X setup, content, QA and handover.



Applications with relevant live work and specific answers will receive priority. Please identify team projects clearly and explain your personal contribution.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

Click the link - 

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: Sales Operations Support Coordinator
description:
About the role



We are looking for a curious, dependable and highly organized Sales Operations Support Coordinator to help keep our sales team running smoothly.



This role combines sales administration, process compliance, product training coordination and recruitment support. You will be trusted to follow tasks through from beginning to end, ask thoughtful questions when something is unclear and ensure that no detail is overlooked.



This position is ideal for someone who takes genuine pride in their work. You should be willing to help wherever reasonably required and understand that both small administrative tasks and larger projects contribute to the success of the team.



As our business evolves, you will also be expected to learn new areas and take ownership of agreed projects and reasonable duties across the wider business. This is a varied role for someone who is adaptable, willing to contribute wherever needed and equally committed to routine responsibilities and larger projects.



Key responsibilities

* Sales processes and compliance

* Conduct regular checks to ensure the sales team follows established standard operating procedures.

* Maintain clear checklists and records of completed compliance checks.

* Identify missing steps, documentation or follow-ups and address them promptly.

* Follow each matter through to completion rather than assuming someone else will finish it.

* Provide concise updates to management on recurring issues and areas requiring attention.

* Suggest practical process improvements when gaps or inefficiencies are identified.



Product training and knowledge base

* Prepare and organize training materials for new products.

* Upload, structure and maintain content in Zoho Learn.

* Keep the company knowledge base accurate, current and easy to navigate.

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain product files, specifications, images and other required information.

* Ensure relevant team members receive everything needed for product launches and sales training.

* Track outstanding information and follow up until it is received.

* Ask questions and confirm expectations whenever instructions or product information are unclear.



Recruitment support

* Prepare and post sales recruitment advertisements on SEEK and other approved channels.

* Review applications against agreed selection criteria.

* Conduct initial candidate screening by
, phone or video call.

* Maintain accurate candidate records and prepare clear shortlists for management.

* Coordinate interviews and communicate professionally with applicants.

* Handle applicant information responsibly and confidentially.



Daily roster and attendance support

* Prepare and monitor the team’s daily break roster.

* Check arrival times and attendance against agreed schedules.

* Record exceptions accurately and follow the appropriate escalation process.

* Communicate reminders professionally, consistently and fairly.

* Maintain accurate records so information can be easily reviewed when required.



Projects and evolving priorities

* Take ownership of new operational projects and change business priorities as assigned by management.

* Clarify the required outcome, scope, priority, deadline and stakeholders before commencing unfamiliar work.

* Turn instructions into a practical action plan with clear steps, responsibilities and due dates.

* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers or other stakeholders as required.

* Track actions, dependencies and risks and provide clear progress updates.

* Ask questions and raise potential obstacles early rather than making assumptions or waiting until a deadline is missed.

* Carry projects through from initial instruction to completion, implementation and handover.

* Create or update the relevant SOP, checklist or supporting documentation when a project introduces a repeatable process.

* When project work competes with recurring responsibilities, confirm priorities with the manager so existing duties are not silently delayed or dropped.



General Operations: 

* Monitoring operations and reporting on performance.

* Helping implement new workflows, tools and processes.

* Troubleshooting operational issues.

* Coordinating across departments and with external suppliers.

* Analyzing information and preparing useful reports.

* Supporting onboarding and SOP training.



How we expect you to work



We are looking for someone who:

* Is naturally curious and wants to understand the reason behind a task.

* Asks sensible questions when unsure instead of guessing or remaining silent.

* Listens carefully and follows instructions accurately.

* Takes responsibility for tasks from commencement through to completion.

* Pays close attention to details and checks their work before submitting it.

* Is reliable, responsible and consistent—even when working independently.

* Follows established processes rather than creating unnecessary shortcuts.

* Completes all reasonable duties within the role instead of selecting only preferred tasks.

* Approaches small routine tasks with the same care as larger projects.

* Keeps files, trackers, messages and priorities organized.

* Communicates early if a deadline may be missed or assistance is required.

* Creates clear handover notes and ensures essential processes are covered before taking leave.

* Is honest, genuine and trustworthy in their communication and work.

* Accepts feedback positively and applies it to future work.

* Closes the loop by confirming when work has been completed.



Skills and experience

* At least two years’ experience in sales administration, operations support, recruitment coordination or a similar role.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

* Confidence in politely holding people accountable to agreed processes and deadlines.

* Ability to manage several recurring responsibilities without constant supervision.

* Experience maintaining SOPs, checklists, trackers or knowledge bases.

* Sound judgement when working with confidential recruitment and attendance information.

* Competence with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

* Experience coordinating or managing projects from initial brief through to completion.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and time-management skills.

* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and processes quickly.

* Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue.

* Experience identifying operational bottlenecks and recommending practical improvements.

* Experience with Zoho Learn, other Zoho applications, SEEK or an Australian business will be highly regarded but is not essential.



Working arrangements

* Location: Remote, Philippines

* Hours: Mondays to Fridays 9am-5.30pm

* Time zone: Australian Eastern Standard Time, including daylight-saving changes.

* Employment type: Full-time

* Salary: PHP 50,000 per month, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and health-insurance benefits. 

* Start date: ASAP

* The successful candidate will require a reliable internet connection, a suitable home workspace and the ability to attend online meetings during the required working hours.



How to apply



Please submit:

* Your résumé.

* A short introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this role interests you.

* An example of a process, checklist, tracker or knowledge base you have maintained.

* An example of a task you managed from initial instruction through to completion.

* Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

* Your availability and notice period.



Please begin your application with the words “Sales Operations” so we know you have read the advertisement carefully.

title: Executive & Project Assistant
description:
PLEASE READ JOB POST IN ITS ENTIRETY 



Executive & Administrative Assistant



We are looking for someone who does more than complete assigned tasks.



We are looking for a responsive, resourceful, and highly organized Project & Administrative Assistant who can work directly with the Founder, support multiple areas of the business, and think beyond what is immediately in front of them.



This role is ideal for someone who naturally asks, “What needs to happen next?”



As you learn the business, we want you to become an extension of the Founder—someone who keeps track of moving pieces, notices what may be missing, follows through, and helps us stay a few steps ahead.



About NSM Consulting Group



NSM Consulting Group is a Washington, DC-based event production and consulting company. We support organizations through the planning and execution of events, programs, trainings, and special projects.



We are a growing small business, which means our needs can change from week to week. We value excellent work, strong communication, resourcefulness, flexibility, and people who take ownership of what they do.



Position Overview



The Project & Administrative Assistant will provide ongoing administrative, project, and event support to the Founder and NSM Consulting Group.



This is a flexible role. You may organize project files, maintain trackers, prepare invoices, conduct research, proofread client materials, prepare meeting resources, or help support a virtual event.



You will receive direction and training, but you will not always receive step-by-step instructions for every assignment. We need someone who can understand the desired outcome, use available resources, think through what may be needed, and ask thoughtful questions when necessary.



As the role develops, responsibilities may evolve based on the needs of the company.



Key Responsibilities



Organize and maintain digital files, folders, documents, and company records.



Maintain project trackers, task lists, deadlines, and follow-up items.



Prepare invoices, receipts, and basic administrative documentation.



Format, proofread, and review
s, presentations, documents, and client-facing materials.



Conduct research and summarize findings clearly.



Prepare materials and resources for meetings, client projects, and events.



Support virtual events, webinars, trainings, and meetings as needed.



Assist with attendee communications, registration lists, surveys, links, presentations, and other event logistics.



Track meeting notes, decisions, action items, and outstanding information.



Follow up on open items without waiting to be reminded.



Identify missing information, potential issues, or next steps and bring them forward proactively.



Help improve templates, systems, processes, and organization.



Learn and use new platforms or technology as business needs evolve.



Provide general project and administrative support as needed.



Required Qualifications



Previous experience providing administrative, project, executive, program, event, or similar professional support.



Strong experience using Google Workspace, including Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail, and Meet.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Excellent attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.



Ability to work independently and take initiative.



Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.



Ability to research and learn unfamiliar tasks, tools, or processes.



Ability to receive constructive feedback and apply it to future work.



Reliable access to a computer and stable internet connection.



Ability to protect confidential company and client information.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting a founder, executive, entrepreneur, or small business.



Experience with project coordination or event support.



Experience supporting virtual events, webinars, or online trainings.



Experience with Canva.



Experience with invoicing, expense documentation, or basic business administration.



Experience with project-management platforms.



Experience working successfully with a remote team.



Experience working across multiple projects or clients simultaneously.



Specific software experience beyond Google Workspace is helpful but not required. The platforms we use may evolve, and the right person must be comfortable learning and adapting to new technology.



What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role when:



Assigned work is completed accurately and on time.



The Founder does not have to repeatedly follow up on assigned responsibilities.



Files, project information, and documentation remain organized.



Deadlines and open items are actively tracked.



Details are reviewed before work is considered complete.



Questions and potential problems are communicated early.



You make a reasonable effort to research and solve problems before immediately escalating them.



Feedback is reflected in your future work.



You begin anticipating reasonable next steps as you become familiar with the business.



You recognize when something may have been overlooked and bring it to the Founder's attention.



The Founder can trust that when something is assigned to you, it will either be handled or proactively communicated about.



You May Be a Strong Fit If You



Naturally think a few steps ahead.



Notice details other people may overlook.



Take ownership of your work from beginning to end.



Follow through on what you say you will do.



Are comfortable figuring things out when you do not immediately know the answer.



Know how to research, troubleshoot, and use available resources.



Ask thoughtful questions rather than waiting for every step to be provided.



Communicate proactively instead of disappearing when something becomes difficult.



Can balance flexibility with organization.



Receive direct feedback without becoming defensive.



Apply what you learn so the same correction does not have to be given repeatedly.



Take pride in doing excellent work even when no one is watching.



Most importantly, you are interested in becoming an extension of the Founder.



As you learn the business, we want you to recognize not only what you were asked to do, but also what may need to happen next.



Please Do Not Apply If You



Need repeated reminders to complete routine responsibilities.



Need detailed step-by-step instructions for every assignment.



Struggle to meet deadlines or communicate when something changes.



Regularly overlook details in documents,
s, dates, links, or instructions.



Stop when you encounter something you do not know how to do.



Are uncomfortable researching or learning independently.



Prefer to complete only the exact task assigned without considering obvious next steps.



Have difficulty managing changing priorities.



Are unwilling to accept constructive feedback or take ownership of mistakes.



Are looking for a role where the responsibilities will remain exactly the same.



Hours & Compensation



This is a part-time remote position starting at approximately 10 hours per week, with the potential to grow to approximately 20 hours per week as the role and business grow.



Some work can be completed on a flexible schedule. However, meetings, client needs, deadlines, and virtual events may require availability during specified U.S. Eastern Time hours.



The selected candidate will begin with a 30-day paid trial period. Successful completion of the trial period may lead to continuation in the ongoing part-time role.



TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, you must complete BOTH of the following:



1. Submit Your Application



Submit your application for the Project & Administrative Assistant position, including your résumé and any requested information.



2. Complete the Written Interview



Complete the NSM Consulting Group Written Interview using the Google Form below:




.com/applynsm



The written interview is a required part of the application process and gives us an opportunity to learn more about how you think, communicate, solve problems, and approach your work.



Your application will not be considered complete until both your application and the Google Form Written Interview have been submitted.



Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted for a virtual screening interview.



Please review all instructions carefully before submitting. We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Operations & Marketing Coordinator
description:
OPERATIONS & MARKETING COORDINATOR



Part-Time | Approximately 20 Hours/Week | $700–$800 USD/Month, Based on Experience | Long-Term | Remote



Hi! I’m Charesse, founder of Level Best, an operations consulting firm serving financial advisory firms, and creator of FinOps Co-op® (FOCO), an online community and resource hub for financial operations professionals.



I currently run the business independently, and I’m ready to bring on someone who can take meaningful ownership of the recurring work that keeps the business moving.



I do my best work when I can focus on vision, relationships, business development, and creating great work for our audience and clients. I’m looking for someone who does their best work on the other side of that equation — bringing organization to moving pieces, turning ideas into action, and making sure the details and follow-through happen.



This role requires someone who can work independently and take ownership while communicating well. We’ll primarily collaborate asynchronously using tools like ClickUp and Loom, with a weekly meeting to align on priorities, questions, and what’s ahead.



This is a long-term role, and I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with the business.



Responsibilities generally fall into four areas. Percentages are approximate and may shift over time.





WHAT YOU’LL OWN



FOCO OPERATIONS & ONLINE COMMUNITY — APPROX. 40%



FOCO is an online membership community with virtual programming, resources, and events.



• Coordinate virtual speakers, including scheduling, collecting materials, reminders, and follow-up

• Support webinars, open sessions, and other online programming from planning through follow-up

• Post session replays and supporting resources

• Support new member onboarding and routine member requests

• Maintain our online Training & Templates Library

• Keep programming calendars, deadlines, and recurring responsibilities organized



Attendance at live FOCO events is not required.





MARKETING EXECUTION — APPROX. 35%



• Build and prepare
 newsletters

• Create and update graphics in Canva

• Turn webinars and other long-form content into short promotional clips

• Repurpose existing content for social and other marketing

• Prepare speaker, event, and partner promotional materials

• Prepare and schedule LinkedIn content

• Upload and organize YouTube content

• Make routine website and content updates





SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SUPPORT — APPROX. 15%



I’ll continue to lead sales conversations, relationship building, and closing business. You’ll help make sure the process around those activities stays organized.



• Maintain lead and opportunity information

• Keep the sales pipeline organized and current

• Track leads generated through speaking engagements, webinars, referrals, and marketing

• Coordinate follow-up, scheduling, and sales materials

• Flag opportunities and next steps that need my attention



This is not a cold-calling or sales-closing role.





LEVEL BEST OPERATIONS & PROCESS SUPPORT — APPROX. 10%



• Support special projects, research, and general business operations

• Maintain and update existing SOPs and checklists as processes evolve

• Help establish recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and event-driven routines as you learn the role

• Keep shared resources and documentation organized

• Identify opportunities to make recurring work simpler or more efficient





WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



• At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in operations, marketing coordination, project coordination, online community management, executive support, or a similar role

• Highly organized with experience owning recurring responsibilities, managing deadlines, and coordinating multiple moving pieces

• Clear and professional written and spoken English

• Takes initiative, follows through, and is comfortable figuring things out without needing step-by-step direction

• Tech-savvy, resourceful, and comfortable using AI and learning new systems

• Good judgment about when to move something forward independently and when to ask for input



Financial services experience is not required. I care more about your ability to learn, organize, communicate, execute, and take ownership.





TECHNOLOGY



Our current technology stack includes:



Circle, Canva, Descript, Mailchimp, WordPress, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Workspace, Zoom, ThriveCart, ClickUp, Zapier, CRM/sales tools, Loom, and AI tools.



You do not need experience with every platform.



You should have strong hands-on experience with Canva and Google Workspace, along with experience across several areas such as
 marketing, social/content publishing, video editing, project management, online community platforms, CRM, or website management.



Experience with Mailchimp, Descript, Circle, ClickUp, WordPress, or similar platforms is especially helpful. Familiarity with Zapier or other automation tools is a plus, but not required.



You should also be comfortable using AI tools in your work and learning unfamiliar technology independently.





SCHEDULE & ROLE DETAILS



• 20 hours per week

• $700–$800 USD/month, based on experience

• Long-term opportunity

• 100% remote

• Majority of work can be completed asynchronously during your preferred working hours

s, posts, and other communications should be scheduled for appropriate U.S. business hours when needed

You must have reliable internet, your own reliable computer, and a private work environment appropriate for handling confidential business information.





HOW TO APPLY

title: FEMALE Performance Video Editor — Paid Social
description:
D2C Jewelry · Remote · Independent Contractor · GMT+8 Overlap Required



Who we are

We are a fast-growing demi-fine jewelry brand creating earrings women can actually live in.



Our hero product, the Stay Close Hoop, is a backless hoop designed for comfortable, uninterrupted wear. We've served 175,000+ customers across the US, UK, Australia, Canada and Europe, backed by 7,000+ five-star reviews.



We're looking for a female video editor with exceptional taste in content made for women to join our creative team.



The role

- You'll work alongside a Creative Strategist to turn briefs into high-performing Meta and TikTok ads.

- This role sits at the intersection of aesthetic taste and performance creative.

- You need to understand the visual world our female customer lives in — jewelry, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, GRWM and creator content — while also knowing how to make an ad hook, hold attention and convert.

- We're not looking for cinematic brand films.

- We're looking for beautiful ads that sell.



What you'll do



Edit paid social ads at volume.

Turn structured creative briefs into compelling short-form ads using creator/UGC footage, product footage, testimonials, photography and other assets.



Make jewelry desirable.

Have a strong eye for product close-ups, ear stacks, styling, composition, typography, music and shot selection. You should instinctively know which shot makes someone think: I want those earrings.



Create content native to women's feeds.

Your work should feel at home alongside the jewelry, beauty, fashion and lifestyle content women already consume on TikTok and Instagram — not like a traditional advertisement dropped into their feed.



Build variants of winners.

Create new hooks, openings, pacing, overlays, product reveals, testimonials and CTAs around proven concepts so we can systematically find what improves performance.



Turn raw UGC into great ads.

Find the strongest hooks, reactions, product moments and soundbites from creator footage and restructure them into ads that feel natural while still selling.



Use AI where useful.

AI isn't the focus of the role, but you should be comfortable using modern image/video and voice tools when they can efficiently fill a footage gap or improve an edit.



Learn from performance.

You'll see how your ads perform and should understand metrics like hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA well enough to form a point of view on what worked and what to test next.



What we're looking for

- Exceptional female-focused aesthetic taste. Your portfolio must demonstrate strong TikTok or Instagram content created for female audiences. Jewelry, beauty, fashion and lifestyle experience is highly relevant.

- Paid social experience. You've edited performance ads for a D2C/e-commerce brand or performance agency and understand that creative ultimately gets judged by results.

- Strong short-form instincts. You understand hooks, retention, pacing, mobile-first typography, product reveals, UGC storytelling and direct-response structure.

- Speed. You can produce and iterate quickly without becoming sloppy. You know which details affect performance and which don't.

- Ownership. You don't blindly execute briefs. If a hook isn't working visually or the footage isn't supporting the concept, you flag it and propose a solution

- Organization. You're comfortable managing multiple concepts and variants with clean naming, version control and ClickUp handoffs.



We're tool-agnostic — Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut or similar are all fine.



Nice to have: jewelry/beauty/fashion experience, motion graphics, TikTok Spark Ads, AI-assisted production and localization experience.



Who you'll work with

- You'll work inside an ARDANT creative pod, led by a Creative Strategist and potentially alongside other Video Editors.

The strategist owns the audience, angle and persuasion strategy.

- You own making it visually compelling enough to stop someone and clear enough to sell.



Who this isn't for

- This isn't the right role if your strongest work is long-form brand films, you don't regularly consume female-focused TikTok/Instagram content, you need weeks to finish an asset, or you dislike creating multiple iterations of the same concept.



At ARDANT, creative gets tested quickly.



We care less about defending an edit and more about finding the edit that wins.



Logistics

Engagement: Independent contractor

Location: Fully remote

Timezone: Meaningful GMT+8 overlap required

Compensation: Monthly fee + performance bonus

Tools: Required software/AI credits covered by ARDANT



How to apply

Keep it simple. Send us:



1. Your portfolio

Show us your best TikTok/Instagram work, especially content created for female audiences in jewelry, beauty, fashion or lifestyle.



2. Your best 3 paid social ads

For each, tell us in one or two sentences what you edited and, if available, how it performed.



3. One sentence:

What's one thing most video editors get wrong when creating ads for women?



That's it.



Paid test

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid ARDANT editing test using a real brief, raw creator footage and product assets.



We'll evaluate:



Aesthetic Taste · Hook Execution · Product Presentation · Pacing · Performance Thinking · Speed



We're not looking for the fanciest editor.



We're looking for someone who can consistently turn an ARDANT brief into an ad women want to watch and buy from.

title: Surplus Recovery Case Coordinator
description:
Surploom is a young company that helps people pursue surplus funds after tax sales and mortgage foreclosures. We’ve also just launched **SurploomOS**, our software for surplus recovery work.



We’re looking for a reliable, organized person to help coordinate individual surplus recovery cases when needed. This is **not a part-time or full-time position**. Work is assigned case by case, so there are no guaranteed cases, hours, or monthly earnings. We currently have two interested claimants who may need help.



## What you’ll do



For each case assigned to you, you may:



- Review the lead details, including the sale type, county, property address, case number, sale date, claimant, and available records.

- Research the applicable state, county, and court procedures. Contact the appropriate county office, court, trustee, or sale office to confirm whether funds are being held and ask what claim process, documents, and deadlines apply.

- Follow **all applicable state and county rules and procedures for that case**. Requirements vary by state, county, and sale type, so the steps may differ or be more extensive from one case to another. Following the applicable rules is mandatory, with no exceptions. If you cannot confirm what the rules require, pause and ask Surploom before proceeding.

- Keep clear records of the instructions you receive, sources checked, deadlines, and follow-up needed.

- Speak with claimants by phone, explain updates clearly and respectfully, and help them gather and organize documents requested by the relevant office.

- Coordinate administrative forms or submissions when appropriate.

- Follow up with the relevant office, track the case, and keep the claimant informed until the funds are paid or the case reaches another outcome.

- If a case may need legal help, contact an appropriate specialized attorney from Surploom’s approved network and coordinate the referral and next steps with the claimant.



**The steps listed above are examples, not a complete checklist for every case.** Some cases may require additional steps, documents, research, follow-up, or coordination depending on the state, county, sale type, and claimant’s circumstances. You are expected to identify and complete the steps required for each specific case while following Surploom’s instructions and applicable rules.



## Requirements



- Be available for calls and follow-up during agreed **U.S. business hours**. The schedule will depend on the claimant, county, and case needs.

- Be comfortable making and receiving phone calls with U.S. claimants and government or court offices.

- Speak English clearly and be easy to understand over the phone. **A perfect American accent is not required.**

- Communicate professionally, patiently, and respectfully, including when discussing sensitive situations such as a former home, financial hardship, or a deceased family member.

- Be organized, dependable, careful with confidential information, and consistent about documenting calls, deadlines, and next steps.

- Be willing to research unfamiliar state and county procedures and ask for guidance whenever a requirement is unclear.



This role does not require a law degree or legal license. It does require careful research and strict compliance with the rules that apply to each case. You must not provide legal advice, d
 who is legally entitled to funds, or perform legal work.



## Compensation and estimated workload



The proposed pay is **$120 per assigned claimant case**, paid in stages as work is completed:



- **$40** after the initial case review and confirmation of the process and funds holder.

- **$40** after the claimant’s requested documents are organized and any appropriate administrative submission or handoff is completed.

- **$40** after the case’s final status is confirmed and the case record is updated.



Payment is for the coordination work and does not depend on whether the claimant ultimately receives funds. If a case requires substantially more steps or work than expected, any additional payment must be discussed and agreed upon before that extra work begins. Attorney fees and other case expenses are separate.



The workload may average **up to approximately 10 hours per week when cases are assigned**, but hours can vary from week to week. There is no guarantee of 10 hours each week or of ongoing work.



**Earnings examples:**



- **1 case completed in a month:** $150

- **2 cases completed in a month:** $300

- **4 cases completed in a month:** $600

- **8 cases completed in a month:** $1,200



These are examples only. Actual earnings depend on how many cases Surploom assigns and the work required for each case. Some cases may take longer or require additional steps, and case work may continue over multiple weeks or months.



## Potential future opportunities



As Surploom grows, this work could potentially develop into a larger or full-time role, but **there is no guarantee**. Surploom is a young company, and we launched SurploomOS today.



If SurploomOS gains clients who need help coordinating their own surplus cases, there may also be opportunities to support those clients for additional pay. Any such work and compensation would be discussed and agreed upon in advance; it is not guaranteed.



## To apply



Please send a short introduction describing your experience with case coordination, document preparation, customer communication, or researching and contacting government or court offices. Include your availability during U.S. business hours, your experience handling phone calls.

title: Sales Supervisor - Smart Moving
description:
4US Moving is looking for an experienced Sales Supervisor to lead, coach, and support our sales team while helping maintain a smooth and accurate booking process.



This is primarily a sales leadership and quality assurance role, rather than an individual sales position. You’ll stay closely involved with daily sales activity, support the team’s development, review call and booking quality, and help ensure customers receive a consistent experience from initial inquiry through booking.



We’re looking for someone who understands the moving industry and moving sales, enjoys developing people, and can bring structure, accountability, and positive energy to the team. While your primary focus will be leadership, your sales experience will also allow you to step in and support representatives when needed.



What You’ll Do

1. Lead and support the day-to-day performance of the sales team

2. Monitor leads, follow-ups, estimates, bookings, and sales activity

3. Review calls and bookings for quality and accuracy

4. Ensure important customer, move, inventory, pricing, payment, and scheduling details are properly documented

5. Track key metrics such as conversion, booked revenue, follow-up activity, and team performance

6. Coach representatives on lead handling, estimating, follow-up, objection handling, and closing

7. Provide ongoing feedback, training, and performance support

8. Help team members who may need additional coaching or development

9. Improve sales processes, scripts, training materials, and QA practices

10. Support the onboarding and training of new sales representatives

11. Step in to assist with challenging customers or sales opportunities when needed

12. Work closely with operations to support smooth handoffs of booked moves

13. Share performance trends, challenges, and improvement opportunities with management



Must-Have Qualifications

- Direct experience working within the moving industry

- Hands-on proficiency with SmartMoving

- Hands-on proficiency with RingCentral

- Previous experience leading or supervising a sales team

- Strong understanding of moving sales, estimating, and booking workflows

- What Else We Value

- Experience coaching and developing sales representatives

- Understanding of sales KPIs, conversion, lead management, and follow-up

- Experience reviewing sales calls and providing constructive feedback

- Strong sales skills and the ability to support representatives when needed

- Excellent attention to detail and organization

- Strong technical aptitude and confidence using multiple systems

- Excellent verbal and written English communication

- A collaborative, proactive, and energetic leadership style

- Availability to work consistently during U.S. business hours



Nice to Have

- Russian-speaking ability is highly preferred

- Experience managing remote or offshore teams

- Experience developing sales training, QA practices, or sales processes



Who Will Succeed in This Role

You’ll be a great fit if you’re a hands-on and supportive sales leader who enjoys helping people improve.



You stay connected to what’s happening with your team, catch issues early, and provide the coaching and guidance needed - to keep performance and booking quality on track.



While this isn't primarily an individual sales position, having strong sales experience is important. It will help you coach with -credibility, recognize opportunities, and support the team when needed.
